know: Judas used his sword for the rest of his life (1 Macc 3:12).

people.name: Appaim
people.summary: Son of Nadab in the genealogy of Judah, among the Jerahmeelites (1 Chr 2:30-31).

people.name: Aran
people.summary: Son of Dishan in the genealogy of Seir the Horite (Gen 36:28; 1 Chr 1:42).

people.name: Archippus
people.summary: Archippus, Paul's 'fellow soldier', is greeted in Philemon and told in Colossians to fulfil the ministry he has received in the Lord.
know: Called 'our fellow soldier' (Philem 2).
Charged to fulfil his ministry (Col 4:17).

people.name: Ard
people.summary: A son of Benjamin who went down to Egypt with Jacob's household.
know: Listed among the seventy of Jacob's house who came to Egypt (Gen 46)

people.name: Areli
people.summary: A son of Gad who went down to Egypt with Jacob's household.
know: Listed among the seventy of Jacob's house who came to Egypt (Gen 46)

people.name: Arioch
people.summary: Arioch, king of Ellasar, was one of the four eastern kings who warred against the cities of the plain and carried off Lot; Abram defeated them.
know: One of the 'four kings against the five' (Gen 14:9)

people.name: Arius king of the Spartans
people.summary: The Spartan king (Areus) whose earlier letter to the high priest Onias claimed kinship between Spartans and Jews as descendants of Abraham; Jonathan appealed to it in renewing friendship.
know: Letter quoted in 1 Macc 12:20-23.

people.name: Ashhur
people.summary: Son of Hezron and Abijah in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 2:24; 4:5-7). Called 'the father of Tekoa', i.e. founder of that town.

people.name: Ashkenaz
people.summary: Son of Gomer in the genealogy of the Table of Nations (Gen 10:3; 1 Chr 1:6).

people.name: Asmodaeus
people.summary: 'The evil spirit' who killed each of Sarah's seven husbands on their wedding night. When Tobias burned the fish's heart and liver as Raphael instructed, the demon fled to upper Egypt, where Raphael bound him.
people.catholic: The episode illustrates the Church's teaching that the devil and demons are real but defeated creatures whose power is limited by God (CCC 391-395). The remedy combines a sign with prayer — the couple rise and pray together (Tob 8:4-8) — and Christian tradition has seen in it a figure of deliverance from evil through prayer and the sacramentals.
know: Spelled 'Asmodaeus' in this translation.
Killed Sarah's seven husbands (Tob 3:8).
Fled to Egypt and was bound by Raphael (Tob 8:3).

people.name: Asshur
people.summary: A son of Shem listed in the Table of Nations.
know: Ancestor of the Assyrians

people.name: Assir
people.summary: Son of Abiasaph in the genealogy of Levi, among the Kohathites (1 Chr 6:23; 6:37).

people.name: Attai
people.summary: Son of Jarha and Daughter of Sheshan in the genealogy of Judah, among the Jerahmeelites (1 Chr 2:35-36).

people.name: Azariah
people.summary: Son of Jehu in the genealogy of Judah, among the Jerahmeelites (1 Chr 2:38-39).

people.name: Azariah son of Hoshaiah
people.summary: Azariah son of Hoshaiah, with Johanan and 'all the proud men', accused Jeremiah of lying when he told the remnant not to go to Egypt.
know: Possibly the same as 'Jezaniah son of Hoshaiah' in Jer 42:1.

people.name: Azariah son of Oded
people.summary: Azariah son of Oded, filled with the Spirit of God, met Asa returning from victory and told him 'the LORD is with you while you are with him', prompting Asa's reform and covenant renewal.
know: His prophecy led to Asa's reform

people.name: Azariah the priest
people.summary: Azariah the chief priest, with eighty priests, confronted King Uzziah when he tried to burn incense in the Temple, and drove him out when leprosy broke out on his forehead.
know: Withstood the king in the sanctuary

people.name: Azmaveth
people.summary: Son of Jehoaddah in the genealogy of Benjamin, house of Saul (1 Chr 8:36; 9:42).

people.name: Azor
people.summary: Azor, son of Eliakim, appears only in Matthew's genealogy of Jesus as the father of Zadok (Mt 1:13-14), in the line of David's royal heirs after the Babylonian exile.
know: Named only in Matthew 1 - a link in Jesus' royal Davidic line after the exile.
Son of Eliakim; father of Zadok.

people.name: Azrikam
people.summary: Son of Azel in the genealogy of Benjamin, house of Saul (1 Chr 8:38; 9:44).

people.name: Azrikam
people.summary: Son of Hashabiah in the genealogy of the Levites who resettled Jerusalem (1 Chr 9:14; Neh 11:15).

people.name: Azubah
people.role: Wife of Caleb son of Hezron
people.summary: Azubah was the wife of Caleb son of Hezron; after her death Caleb married Ephrath (1 Chr 2:18-19).

people.name: Azubah
people.summary: Azubah daughter of Shilhi, wife of Asa, was the mother of King Jehoshaphat.
know: Mother of Jehoshaphat

people.name: Baal
people.summary: Son of Jeiel and Maacah in the genealogy of Benjamin, house of Saul (1 Chr 8:30; 9:36).

people.name: Barachel
people.summary: The Buzite father of Elihu.
know: Known only as Elihu's father.

people.name: Bedad
people.summary: Bedad is the father of Hadad, king of Edom (Gen 36:35; 1 Chr 1:46).

people.name: Beor
people.summary: Beor is the father of Bela, the first king listed as reigning in Edom (Gen 36:32; 1 Chr 1:43); distinct from Balaam's father.

people.name: Berechiah
people.summary: Berechiah son of Shimea, a Gershonite Levite, was the father of Asaph, David's chief singer (1 Chr 6:39; 15:17).

people.name: Berechiah
people.summary: Berechiah son of Iddo was the father of the prophet Zechariah.
know: Ezra 5:1 and 6:14 skip him, calling Zechariah 'son of Iddo'.

people.name: Beriah
people.summary: Son of Elpaal in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:13; 8:16). He and Shema were heads in Aijalon and put the inhabitants of Gath to flight.

people.name: Bilhan
people.summary: Son of Ezer in the genealogy of Seir the Horite (Gen 36:27; 1 Chr 1:42).

people.name: Binea
people.summary: Son of Moza in the genealogy of Benjamin, house of Saul (1 Chr 8:37; 9:43).

people.name: Bocheru
people.summary: Son of Azel in the genealogy of Benjamin, house of Saul (1 Chr 8:38; 9:44).

people.name: Cainan, son of Arphaxad
people.summary: Cainan appears in Luke's genealogy between Arphaxad and Shelah ('the son of Shelah, the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad', Lk 3:35-36). He is absent from the Hebrew text of Genesis 11 but present in the Greek Septuagint, which Luke follows.
know: Named only in Luke 3:36 (and the Septuagint of Genesis 11).
Distinct from Cainan (Kenan) son of Enos in Luke 3:37.
Shows Luke's use of the Greek Old Testament.

people.name: Calcol
people.summary: Son of Zerah in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 2:6; 1 Kgs 4:31).

people.name: Cheran
people.summary: Son of Dishon in the genealogy of Seir the Horite (Gen 36:26; 1 Chr 1:41).

people.name: Chileab
people.summary: Chileab, David's second son, born of Abigail at Hebron, is called Daniel in Chronicles; nothing else is recorded of him.
know: Also called Daniel

people.name: Claudius
people.summary: Claudius was Roman emperor (AD 41-54). Acts dates the famine foretold by Agabus to his reign and notes that he expelled all Jews from Rome, which brought Aquila and Priscilla to Corinth.
know: The famine of Acts 11:28 happened 'in the days of Claudius'.
His edict expelling Jews from Rome (Acts 18:2) is also mentioned by the Roman historian Suetonius.

people.name: Claudius Lysias
people.summary: Claudius Lysias was the commanding officer of the Roman cohort in Jerusalem who rescued Paul from a mob in the Temple, learned that Paul was a Roman citizen by birth while he had bought his own citizenship, and, on learning of a plot to kill Paul, sent him under heavy guard to Felix with a letter.
know: Rescued Paul from the Temple riot (Acts 21:31-36).
Bought his Roman citizenship 'for a great price' (Acts 22:28).
Wrote to Felix on Paul's behalf (Acts 23:26-30).

people.name: Cleopatra
people.summary: Daughter of Ptolemy VI, married with great pomp to Alexander Balas at Ptolemais and then given by her father to Demetrius II.
know: Not the famous Cleopatra VII of Egypt.
Wife successively of Alexander Balas and Demetrius II (1 Macc 10:58; 11:12).

people.name: Cozbi
people.summary: Daughter of Zur, a Midianite chief, killed by Phinehas together with Zimri during the apostasy at Peor.
know: Daughter of Zur, head of a Midianite house (Num 25:15).
Killed with Zimri by Phinehas.

people.name: Crispus
people.summary: Crispus, ruler of the synagogue at Corinth, believed in the Lord with all his household. He was one of the few Corinthians Paul baptized personally.
know: Ruler of the Corinthian synagogue (Acts 18:8).
Baptized by Paul himself (1 Cor 1:14).

people.name: Cushan Rishathaim
people.summary: King of Mesopotamia (Aram-naharaim) to whom the LORD gave Israel for eight years until Othniel delivered them.
know: Oppressed Israel eight years (Jdg 3:8).
Defeated by Othniel (Jdg 3:10).

people.name: Dara
people.summary: Son of Zerah in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 2:6; 1 Kgs 4:31). Probably the Darda of 1 Kgs 4:31.

people.name: Dedan
people.summary: Son of Raamah in the genealogy of the Table of Nations (Gen 10:7; 1 Chr 1:9).

people.name: Dedan
people.summary: Son of Jokshan in the genealogy of Abraham's descendants through Keturah (Gen 25:3; 1 Chr 1:32).

people.name: Delaiah son of Shemaiah
people.summary: Delaiah was one of the princes who heard Jeremiah's scroll and pleaded with Jehoiakim not to burn it.

people.name: Demetrius the silversmith
people.summary: Demetrius, a silversmith of Ephesus who made silver shrines of Artemis, stirred up the craftsmen against Paul because his preaching threatened their trade and the goddess's honor, provoking a riot in the theater.
know: Made silver shrines of Artemis (Acts 19:24).
Started the Ephesian riot (Acts 19:23-41).

people.name: Diklah
people.summary: Son of Joktan in the genealogy of the Table of Nations (Gen 10:27; 1 Chr 1:21).

people.name: Dishon
people.summary: Son of Anah in the genealogy of Seir the Horite (Gen 36:25; 1 Chr 1:41).

people.name: Dodanim
people.summary: Son of Javan in the genealogy of the Table of Nations (Gen 10:4; 1 Chr 1:7).

people.name: Dumah
people.summary: A son of Ishmael and ancestor of an Arabian tribe.
know: One of the twelve princes descended from Ishmael (Gen 25:16)

people.name: Ebal
people.summary: Son of Shobal in the genealogy of Seir the Horite (Gen 36:23; 1 Chr 1:40).

people.name: Eglah
people.summary: Eglah bore David his sixth son, Ithream, at Hebron.
know: Mother of Ithream

people.name: Elam
people.summary: A son of Shem listed in the Table of Nations.
know: Ancestor of the Elamites, east of Babylonia

people.name: Eldaah
people.summary: Son of Midian in the genealogy of Abraham's descendants through Keturah (Gen 25:4; 1 Chr 1:33).

people.name: Eldad
people.summary: One of the seventy elders chosen to share Moses' burden. Though he stayed in the camp rather than going to the Tent of Meeting, the Spirit rested on him and he prophesied; when Joshua asked Moses to stop him, Moses replied, 'I wish that all the LORD's people were prophets.'
people.catholic: The episode (read on the 26th Sunday in Ordinary Time, Year B, with Mk 9:38-48) is used to teach that the Spirit is not confined by human boundaries, and Moses' wish that all God's people be prophets is seen as fulfilled at Pentecost (Acts 2:17-18) and in the prophetic office shared by all the baptized.
know: One of the seventy elders (Num 11:26).
Prophesied in the camp with Medad.
Moses refused to forbid him (Num 11:29).

people.name: Eleasah
people.summary: Son of Helez in the genealogy of Judah, among the Jerahmeelites (1 Chr 2:39-40).

people.name: Eleasah
people.summary: Son of Raphah in the genealogy of Benjamin, house of Saul (1 Chr 8:37; 9:43).

people.name: Eleazar the scribe
people.summary: One of the principal scribes, a man of ninety, who under Antiochus IV refused to eat swine's flesh and even refused the friendly offer to pretend to eat it, lest he lead the young astray. He went willingly to the rack, declaring that he suffered gladly 'because of my fear of him', leaving his death 'an example of nobleness'.
people.catholic: 1 and 2 Maccabees are deuterocanonical books, received in the Church's canon (Rome 382, Hippo 393, Carthage 397, Florence, and defined at Trent in 1546) though not in the Hebrew Bible or Protestant Old Testament. Eleazar is a model of integrity: he refuses even a pretended apostasy that would scandalize others (2 Macc 6:24-28), anticipating Christian teaching on scandal and martyrdom. The Fathers (e.g. St Gregory Nazianzen's oration on the Maccabees) honored him among the martyrs of the Old Covenant; the Eastern Churches commemorate him with the Maccabean martyrs on August 1, and Heb 11:35 is often read as alluding to these martyrs.
know: Ninety years old (2 Macc 6:24).
Refused to pretend to eat pork (2 Macc 6:21-28).
'Leaving his death for an example of nobleness' (2 Macc 6:31).

people.name: Elhanan
people.summary: Elhanan son of Jaare-Oregim (Jair in Chronicles), a Bethlehemite, killed a giant of Gath at Gob - in this translation 'Goliath the Gittite's brother', named Lahmi in 1 Chronicles 20:5.
know: The Hebrew of 2 Sam 21:19 literally reads that he killed Goliath; translations follow 1 Chr 20:5
One of David's champions against the Philistine giants

people.name: Elioenai
people.summary: Son of Neariah in the genealogy of the royal line of David (1 Chr 3:23; 3:24).

people.name: Elishah
people.summary: Son of Javan in the genealogy of the Table of Nations (Gen 10:4; 1 Chr 1:7).

people.name: Elishua
people.summary: Elishua was a son of David born in Jerusalem (apparently called Elishama in 1 Chr 3:6).
know: Born in Jerusalem

people.name: Eliud
people.summary: Eliud, son of Achim, appears only in Matthew's genealogy of Jesus as the father of Eleazar (Mt 1:14-15), in the line of David's royal heirs after the Babylonian exile.
know: Named only in Matthew 1 - a link in Jesus' royal Davidic line after the exile.
Son of Achim; father of Eleazar.

people.name: Elkanah
people.summary: Son of Mahath in the genealogy of Levi, among the Kohathites (1 Chr 6:35). In the ancestry of Samuel and Heman the singer.

people.name: Elon
people.summary: Zebulunite who judged Israel ten years and was buried at Aijalon in Zebulun.
know: Minor judge from Zebulun (Jdg 12:11).
Judged ten years.

people.name: Elon (son of Zebulun)
people.summary: A son of Zebulun who went down to Egypt with Jacob's household.
know: Listed among the seventy of Jacob's house who came to Egypt (Gen 46)
Not Elon the Hittite or Elon the judge

people.name: Elon the Hittite
people.summary: A Hittite whose daughter married Esau; she is called Basemath in Gen 26:34 and Adah in Gen 36:2.
know: Gen 26:34 and 36:2 give his daughter different names
Not Elon son of Zebulun or Elon the judge

people.name: Elymas
people.summary: Elymas, also called Bar Jesus, was a Jewish sorcerer and false prophet at the court of Sergius Paulus in Paphos who tried to turn the proconsul from the faith. Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, declared him blind for a time, and he groped about seeking someone to lead him by the hand.
know: Also called Bar Jesus (Acts 13:6).
Struck blind for a time at Paul's word (Acts 13:11).

people.name: Enoch (son of Cain)
people.summary: The son of Cain, after whom Cain named the city he built. He was the father of Irad.
know: Not the same person as Enoch of Seth's line who 'walked with God'
The first city was named after him (Gen 4:17)

people.name: Epaphroditus
people.summary: Epaphroditus was sent by the Philippian church to bring their gift to the imprisoned Paul and to serve him. He fell sick nearly to death 'for the work of Christ', recovered, and was sent home with the Letter to the Philippians.
people.catholic: Paul calls him 'your apostle' (Greek apostolos, 'envoy') and asks that such people be held in honor (Phil 2:29).
know: 'My brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier' (Phil 2:25).
Nearly died serving Paul (Phil 2:27-30).
Brought the Philippians' gift (Phil 4:18).

people.name: Ephah
people.summary: Son of Midian in the genealogy of Abraham's descendants through Keturah (Gen 25:4; 1 Chr 1:33).

people.name: Epher
people.summary: Son of Midian in the genealogy of Abraham's descendants through Keturah (Gen 25:4; 1 Chr 1:33).

people.name: Eri
people.summary: A son of Gad who went down to Egypt with Jacob's household.
know: Listed among the seventy of Jacob's house who came to Egypt (Gen 46)

people.name: Eshban
people.summary: Son of Dishon in the genealogy of Seir the Horite (Gen 36:26; 1 Chr 1:41).

people.name: Eshcol
people.summary: An Amorite chief allied with Abram who went with him to rescue Lot and received a share of the spoil.
know: Brother of Mamre and Aner (Gen 14:13)

people.name: Eshton
people.summary: Son of Mehir in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 4:11-12).

people.name: Ethan
people.summary: Son of Zerah in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 2:6; 2:8). Sometimes identified with Ethan the Ezrahite of 1 Kgs 4:31.

people.name: Eupolemus
people.summary: Eupolemus son of John son of Accos, one of the two envoys Judas sent to Rome to make the treaty of friendship.
know: Sent with Jason son of Eleazar (1 Macc 8:17).

people.name: Evi
people.summary: One of the five kings (princes) of Midian killed by Israel in the war of vengeance for Peor, in which Balaam was also slain; Joshua 13:21 calls them princes of Sihon.
know: One of the five kings of Midian (Num 31:8).
Killed in Israel's war against Midian.

people.name: Evilmerodach
people.summary: Evilmerodach (Amel-Marduk), Nebuchadnezzar's successor, released Jehoiachin from prison in the first year of his reign, spoke kindly to him and gave him a place at the king's table for life. Historically he was Nebuchadnezzar's son, though Scripture does not say so.
know: Released Jehoiachin after 37 years

people.name: Gabatha and Tharrha
people.summary: The two royal chamberlains (Bigthan and Teresh in the Hebrew) whose plot to kill Ahasuerus Mordecai overheard and reported; they were executed.
know: Group entry for the two conspirators.
Named in the Greek Addition A (Est 1:1).

people.name: Gabrias
people.summary: Named only to identify Gabael, as his brother (Tob 1:14) or father (Tob 4:20).
know: Mentioned only as Gabael's relative.

people.name: Gaius of Corinth
people.summary: Gaius was one of the few Corinthians Paul baptized himself, and, when Paul wrote Romans from Corinth, he was 'my host and host of the whole assembly'.
know: Baptized by Paul (1 Cor 1:14).
Hosted Paul and the church (Rom 16:23).

people.name: Galal
people.summary: Son of Jeduthun in the genealogy of the Levites who resettled Jerusalem (1 Chr 9:16; Neh 11:17).

people.name: Gamaliel
people.role: Pharisee and teacher of the Law
people.summary: Gamaliel was a Pharisee and teacher of the Law honored by all the people. When the Sanhedrin wanted to kill the apostles, he counselled restraint: if this movement is of men it will fail, but if it is of God they cannot overthrow it. Paul later says he was educated 'at the feet of Gamaliel'.
people.catholic: Gamaliel's counsel (Acts 5:38-39) is often cited as a model of prudent openness to the work of God. Tradition holds that he later became a Christian, and his relics were reported found in 415 together with those of St Stephen.
know: A respected Pharisee and member of the council.
Advised the Sanhedrin to leave the apostles alone (Acts 5:38-39).
Paul's teacher in the Law (Acts 22:3).
Tradition (not Scripture) holds he became a Christian.

people.name: Gedor
people.summary: Son of Jeiel and Maacah in the genealogy of Benjamin, house of Saul (1 Chr 8:31; 9:37).

people.name: Gera
people.summary: Son of Bela in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:3; 8:5). The name Gera appears twice in the list (8:3, 8:5).

people.name: Gether
people.summary: Son of Aram in the genealogy of the Table of Nations (Gen 10:23; 1 Chr 1:17).

people.name: Hacaliah
people.summary: The father of Nehemiah, known only from his son's title.
know: Father of Nehemiah.

people.name: Hadoram
people.summary: Son of Joktan in the genealogy of the Table of Nations (Gen 10:27; 1 Chr 1:21).

people.name: Haggi
people.summary: A son of Gad who went down to Egypt with Jacob's household.
know: Listed among the seventy of Jacob's house who came to Egypt (Gen 46)

people.name: Hanan
people.summary: Son of Azel in the genealogy of Benjamin, house of Saul (1 Chr 8:38; 9:44).

people.name: Hanani
people.summary: Nehemiah's brother, whose report of Jerusalem's broken walls moved Nehemiah to act; later he was put in charge of Jerusalem.
know: Brought the news of Jerusalem's ruin (Neh 1:2-3).
Given charge of Jerusalem (Neh 7:2).

people.name: Hananiah
people.summary: Son of Zerubbabel in the genealogy of the royal line of David (1 Chr 3:19; 3:21).

people.name: Hanoch
people.summary: Son of Midian in the genealogy of Abraham's descendants through Keturah (Gen 25:4; 1 Chr 1:33).

people.name: Hashabiah
people.summary: Son of Bunni in the genealogy of the Levites who resettled Jerusalem (1 Chr 9:14; Neh 11:15).

people.name: Hasshub
people.summary: Son of Azrikam in the genealogy of the Levites who resettled Jerusalem (1 Chr 9:14; Neh 11:15).

people.name: Havilah
people.summary: Son of Cush in the genealogy of the Table of Nations (Gen 10:7; 1 Chr 1:9).

people.name: Havilah
people.summary: Son of Joktan in the genealogy of the Table of Nations (Gen 10:29; 1 Chr 1:23).

people.name: Hazarmaveth
people.summary: Son of Joktan in the genealogy of the Table of Nations (Gen 10:26; 1 Chr 1:20).

people.name: Hebron
people.summary: Son of Mareshah in the genealogy of Judah, among the Calebites (1 Chr 2:42-43).

people.name: Hegai
people.summary: The king's chamberlain in charge of the women, who showed Esther special favor.
know: Keeper of the women (Est 2:8).

people.name: Helah
people.summary: Helah was one of the two wives of Ashhur the father of Tekoa; she bore Zereth, Izhar and Ethnan (1 Chr 4:5, 7).

people.name: Hemam
people.summary: Son of Lotan in the genealogy of Seir the Horite (Gen 36:22; 1 Chr 1:39).

people.name: Hemdan
people.summary: Son of Dishon in the genealogy of Seir the Horite (Gen 36:26; 1 Chr 1:41).

people.name: Hillel
people.summary: Pirathonite, father of the judge Abdon.
know: Father of Abdon (Jdg 12:13).

people.name: Hirah
people.summary: An Adullamite, friend of Judah, with whom Judah stayed and who was sent to deliver the goat to the 'prostitute' (Tamar).
know: Judah's friend from Adullam (Gen 38:1, 12)
Could not find Tamar to pay her (Gen 38:20-22)

people.name: Hobab
people.summary: Son of Reuel the Midianite and brother-in-law of Moses. Moses urged him to journey with Israel and serve as their 'eyes' in the wilderness; his descendants, the Kenites, later settled among Judah.
know: Son of Reuel the Midianite (Num 10:29).
Called Moses' brother-in-law (Jdg 4:11).
Moses asked him to guide Israel through the wilderness (Num 10:31).
Ancestor of the Kenites, including Heber, husband of Jael.

people.name: Hori
people.summary: Son of Lotan in the genealogy of Seir the Horite (Gen 36:22; 1 Chr 1:39).

people.name: Hotham
people.summary: Son of Heber in the genealogy of Asher (1 Chr 7:32; 7:35).

people.name: Hul
people.summary: Son of Aram in the genealogy of the Table of Nations (Gen 10:23; 1 Chr 1:17).

people.name: Huldah
people.summary: Huldah the prophetess, wife of Shallum keeper of the wardrobe, lived in the Second Quarter of Jerusalem. When Josiah's officials brought her the newly found book of the law, she confirmed God's coming judgement on Judah but promised that Josiah, because his heart was tender, would die in peace before it.
people.catholic: Huldah is one of the few women named as prophets in the Old Testament (with Miriam and Deborah); Josiah's officials sought God's word through her, showing that prophetic charism is given to women as well as men - a gift the Church recognises in the Virgin Mary and in women saints and Doctors of the Church.
know: Prophetess consulted by Josiah's officials
Authenticated the book of the law
Foretold judgement and Josiah's peaceful death

people.name: Hur
people.summary: One of the five kings (princes) of Midian killed by Israel in the war of vengeance for Peor, in which Balaam was also slain; Joshua 13:21 calls them princes of Sihon.
know: One of the five kings of Midian (Num 31:8).
Killed in Israel's war against Midian.

people.name: Hushim
people.summary: Hushim, a wife of Shaharaim the Benjamite, bore Abitub and Elpaal (1 Chr 8:8, 11).

people.name: Hymenaeus
people.summary: Hymenaeus made shipwreck of the faith; Paul 'delivered him to Satan' with Alexander so that they might learn not to blaspheme. With Philetus he taught that the resurrection had already taken place, upsetting the faith of some.
people.catholic: His case illustrates the Church's discipline: exclusion from communion meant to be medicinal ('that they might be taught'), and the duty of pastors to guard sound doctrine, including the bodily resurrection to come.
know: Handed over to Satan by Paul (1 Tim 1:20).
Taught that the resurrection was already past (2 Tim 2:17-18).

people.name: Ibzan
people.summary: Judge from Bethlehem who judged Israel seven years; he had thirty sons and thirty daughters and arranged marriages for them all outside his clan.
know: Minor judge from Bethlehem (Jdg 12:8).
Judged seven years.
Thirty sons and thirty daughters (Jdg 12:9).

people.name: Ichabod
people.summary: Ichabod was born the day the Ark was captured; his dying mother named him 'no glory', saying the glory had departed from Israel.
know: His name means roughly 'Where is the glory?'
Brother of Ahitub

people.name: Imlah
people.summary: Imlah was the father of the prophet Micaiah.
know: Known only as Micaiah's father

people.name: Irijah
people.summary: Irijah, captain of the guard at the Benjamin gate, seized Jeremiah as he was leaving Jerusalem, accused him of deserting to the Chaldeans and brought him to the princes, who imprisoned him.
know: Arrested Jeremiah despite his denial (Jer 37:13-14).

people.name: Ishbak
people.summary: A son of Abraham by Keturah, sent away eastward with gifts.
know: Son of Abraham and Keturah (Gen 25:2)

people.name: Ishmael
people.summary: Son of Azel in the genealogy of Benjamin, house of Saul (1 Chr 8:38; 9:44).

people.name: Ishvah
people.summary: A son of Asher who went down to Egypt with Jacob's household.
know: Listed among the seventy of Jacob's house who came to Egypt (Gen 46)

people.name: Ithran
people.summary: Son of Dishon in the genealogy of Seir the Horite (Gen 36:26; 1 Chr 1:41).

people.name: Ithream
people.summary: Ithream was David's sixth son, born of Eglah at Hebron.
know: Born at Hebron

people.name: Jabez
people.summary: Jabez, 'more honourable than his brothers', was named in sorrow by his mother but prayed that God would bless him, enlarge his border and keep him from harm, 'and God granted him that which he requested'.
people.catholic: The short prayer of Jabez is a reminder within the genealogies that God hears personal, confident petition.
know: His prayer is recorded in the middle of a genealogy

people.name: Jacob
people.summary: Jacob son of Matthan is named in Matthew's genealogy as the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, of whom Jesus was born (Mt 1:15-16).
people.catholic: Matthew arranges these generations into three sets of fourteen (Mt 1:17), presenting Jesus as the heir of Abraham and of David's royal house through his legal father Joseph.
know: Father of St Joseph according to Matthew 1:16.
Luke 3:23 instead reads Joseph 'son of Heli'; Julius Africanus (3rd c.) explained the two by a levirate marriage, others take Luke's line as Mary's.
Grandfather (legally) of Jesus.

people.name: Jada
people.summary: Son of Onam in the genealogy of Judah, among the Jerahmeelites (1 Chr 2:28; 2:32).

people.name: Jaddua
people.summary: Jaddua son of Jonathan is the last high priest named in the Old Testament line from Jeshua (Neh 12:10-11, 22).

people.name: Jahath
people.summary: Son of Libni in the genealogy of Levi, among the Gershonites (1 Chr 6:20; 6:42-43). 1 Chr 6:43 calls him 'son of Gershom'.

people.name: Jahleel
people.summary: A son of Zebulun who went down to Egypt with Jacob's household.
know: Listed among the seventy of Jacob's house who came to Egypt (Gen 46)

people.name: Jahzeel
people.summary: A son of Naphtali who went down to Egypt with Jacob's household.
know: Listed among the seventy of Jacob's house who came to Egypt (Gen 46)

people.name: Jair (father of Mordecai)
people.summary: Mordecai's father, a Benjamite descended from Shimei and Kish.
know: Spelled Jair (Est 1:1) and Jairus (Est 2:5).

people.name: Jairus
people.summary: Jairus, a ruler of the synagogue, begged Jesus to come to his dying twelve-year-old daughter. While Jesus was delayed healing a woman with a flow of blood, word came that the girl had died; Jesus said, 'Don't be afraid, only believe', took her by the hand - 'Talitha cumi' - and raised her.
people.catholic: The raising of Jairus's daughter is one of the Gospel signs restoring the dead to earthly life that point to Christ's own, greater Resurrection (CCC 646). Jesus took only Peter, James and John with the parents, a sign of the inner circle.
know: A ruler of the synagogue (Mk 5:22).
'Don't be afraid, only believe' (Mk 5:36).
His daughter, aged twelve, was raised from the dead (Mk 5:41-42).

people.name: Japhlet
people.summary: Son of Heber in the genealogy of Asher (1 Chr 7:32-33).

people.name: Jarha
people.summary: Jarha, an Egyptian servant of Sheshan, married his master's daughter and became ancestor of a thirteen-generation line in Judah (1 Chr 2:34-41).

people.name: Jecoliah
people.summary: Jecoliah (Jechiliah) of Jerusalem was the mother of King Uzziah (Azariah).
know: Mother of Uzziah

people.name: Jehoaddah
people.summary: Son of Ahaz in the genealogy of Benjamin, house of Saul (1 Chr 8:36; 9:42).

people.name: Jehoaddin
people.summary: Jehoaddin (Jehoaddan) of Jerusalem was the mother of King Amaziah.
know: Mother of Amaziah

people.name: Jehosheba
people.summary: Jehosheba (Jehoshabeath), daughter of King Jehoram, sister of Ahaziah and wife of the priest Jehoiada, rescued her infant nephew Joash from Athaliah's massacre and hid him in the Temple for six years.
people.catholic: By saving the last heir of David, Jehosheba preserved the line from which the Messiah would come; she is often compared to the women who protected Moses and to the Holy Family's flight from Herod's massacre.
know: Saved the infant Joash
Wife of Jehoiada the priest
Hid Joash in the Temple six years

people.name: Jehucal son of Shelemiah
people.summary: Jehucal (Jucal) was sent by Zedekiah to ask Jeremiah's prayers, but later joined the officials who demanded Jeremiah's death for weakening the soldiers' morale.
know: Spelled 'Jucal' in Jer 38:1.

people.name: Jemuel
people.summary: A son of Simeon who went down to Egypt with Jacob's household.
know: Listed among the seventy of Jacob's house who came to Egypt (Gen 46)
Called Nemuel in Num 26:12

people.name: Jerah
people.summary: Son of Joktan in the genealogy of the Table of Nations (Gen 10:26; 1 Chr 1:20).

people.name: Jerusha
people.summary: Jerusha daughter of Zadok was the wife of Uzziah and mother of King Jotham.
know: Mother of Jotham

people.name: Jetur
people.summary: A son of Ishmael and ancestor of an Arabian tribe.
know: One of the twelve princes descended from Ishmael (Gen 25:16)

people.name: Joanna
people.summary: Joanna, wife of Chuza, the steward of Herod Antipas, was healed by Jesus and with other women supported him and the Twelve from her means. She was among the women who found the tomb empty and told the apostles.
people.catholic: Joanna shows the Gospel reaching even Herod's court. She is honoured among the myrrh-bearing women, the first heralds of the Resurrection.
know: Wife of Chuza, Herod's steward (Lk 8:3).
Provided for Jesus and the Twelve from her possessions.
Witness of the empty tomb (Lk 24:10).

people.name: Jobab
people.summary: Son of Joktan in the genealogy of the Table of Nations (Gen 10:29; 1 Chr 1:23).

people.name: Jochebed
people.summary: Levite woman, daughter of Levi and wife of Amram, mother of Aaron, Moses and Miriam. When Pharaoh ordered Hebrew boys drowned, she hid the infant Moses for three months, then set him in a papyrus basket on the Nile - and was hired by Pharaoh's daughter to nurse her own son.
people.catholic: Jochebed is a model of courageous motherhood defending a child's life against a death-decree, a scene the Fathers compared with the Holy Family's flight from Herod. The ark-basket (the same Hebrew word as Noah's ark) in which she placed Moses has been read as a figure of salvation through water, and her faith is praised in Hebrews 11:23.
know: Daughter of Levi; wife of Amram (Num 26:59).
Hid Moses three months and placed him in a basket on the Nile (Exo 2:2-3).
Was paid to nurse her own son (Exo 2:9).
Mother of Aaron, Moses and Miriam.

people.name: Joel
people.summary: Joel is the head of a Reubenite line traced down to Beerah, whom Tiglath-pileser deported (1 Chr 5:4-8).

people.name: Joel
people.summary: Joel son of Pethuel saw a devastating plague of locusts as a sign of the coming Day of the LORD and called the people to fasting and wholehearted repentance. He promised that afterwards God would pour out his Spirit on all flesh — sons and daughters, old and young, servants and handmaids.
people.catholic: On Pentecost St Peter declared that Joel's prophecy of the outpouring of the Spirit was fulfilled (Acts 2:16-21); the Church sees in it the gift of the Spirit to the whole messianic people, communicated in Confirmation (CCC 1287). Joel 2:12-18 ('return to me with all your heart... rend your heart and not your garments') is the first reading of Ash Wednesday, opening Lent.
know: Son of Pethuel (Joel 1:1); date of ministry uncertain.
Locust plague as a call to repentance (Joel 1-2).
'I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh' (Joel 2:28) — quoted at Pentecost.
Read on Ash Wednesday.

people.name: Johanan son of Azariah
people.summary: Johanan son of Azariah is listed in the high-priestly line of Eleazar son of Aaron in 1 Chronicles 6.
know: Part of the Aaronic line from Eleazar to the Exile

people.name: Johanan son of Josiah
people.summary: Johanan is listed as Josiah's firstborn but never reigned.
know: Known only from 1 Chr 3:15

people.name: Jonathan
people.summary: Son of Jada in the genealogy of Judah, among the Jerahmeelites (1 Chr 2:32-33).

people.name: Jonathan (Johanan)
people.summary: Jonathan son of Joiada, called Johanan in Neh 12:22, was high priest after his father in the Persian period (Neh 12:10-11, 22).

people.name: Judas (Jude), 'brother of the Lord'
people.summary: Judas (Mark: 'Judah') is listed among the 'brothers' of Jesus by the people of Nazareth (Mt 13:55; Mk 6:3).
people.catholic: The Church understands him as a kinsman of Jesus (CCC 500). Catholic tradition generally identifies him with Jude, 'brother of James', author of the Letter of Jude (Jude 1), and often also with the apostle Jude Thaddeus, though the identifications are traditional rather than certain.
know: Named among Jesus' 'brothers' (Mt 13:55).
Mark's Gospel gives the form 'Judah' (Mk 6:3).
Traditionally linked with the author of the Letter of Jude.

people.name: Julius
people.summary: Julius, a centurion of the Augustan cohort, was in charge of Paul on the voyage to Rome. He treated Paul kindly, let him visit friends at Sidon, and during the shipwreck prevented the soldiers from killing the prisoners in order to save Paul.
know: Of the Augustan band (Acts 27:1).
Saved Paul's life during the shipwreck (Acts 27:42-44).

people.name: Kedar
people.summary: A son of Ishmael and ancestor of an Arabian tribe.
know: One of the twelve princes descended from Ishmael (Gen 25:16)
Kedar became a byword for the Arabian tribes (Ps 120:5; Isa 60:7)

people.name: Kedemah
people.summary: A son of Ishmael and ancestor of an Arabian tribe.
know: One of the twelve princes descended from Ishmael (Gen 25:16)

people.name: Kish
people.summary: Son of Jeiel and Maacah in the genealogy of Benjamin, house of Saul (1 Chr 8:30; 9:36).

people.name: Kishi
people.summary: Kishi (Kushaiah) son of Abdi, a Merarite Levite, was the father of Ethan the singer whom David set over the music (1 Chr 6:44; 15:17).

people.name: Kittim
people.summary: Son of Javan in the genealogy of the Table of Nations (Gen 10:4; 1 Chr 1:7).

people.name: Kore
people.summary: Son of Abiasaph in the genealogy of the Korahite gatekeepers (1 Chr 9:19; 26:1). 'son of Ebiasaph' here means descendant.

people.name: Levi
people.summary: Levi, son of Melchi, appears only in Luke's genealogy of Jesus, which runs from Joseph back through David's son Nathan to Adam; he is listed as the father of Matthat (Lk 3:24).
know: Named only in Luke's genealogy (Lk 3:24).
Son of Melchi; father of Matthat.

people.name: Levi
people.summary: Levi, son of Simeon, appears only in Luke's genealogy of Jesus, which runs from Joseph back through David's son Nathan to Adam; he is listed as the father of Matthat (Lk 3:29).
know: Named only in Luke's genealogy (Lk 3:29).
Son of Simeon; father of Matthat.

people.name: Lo-ruhamah
people.summary: Gomer's daughter, named Lo-ruhamah ('not pitied') as a sign that God would no longer show mercy to the house of Israel; God later promises, 'I will have mercy on her who had not obtained mercy'.
people.catholic: Her renaming from 'not pitied' to 'pitied' is applied in the New Testament to the Church: 'who once had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy' (1 Pet 2:10).
know: Name means 'not pitied / not loved'.
Hos 1:6 does not say she was born 'to him', which some read as a hint of Gomer's infidelity.
Reversed in Hos 2:23.

people.name: Lud
people.summary: A son of Shem listed in the Table of Nations.
know: Ancestor of a people often identified with the Lydians

people.name: Lydia
people.summary: Lydia, a dealer in purple cloth from Thyatira and a worshipper of God, heard Paul at a place of prayer by the river outside Philippi. The Lord opened her heart; she and her household were baptized, and she insisted that the missionaries stay in her house, which became the meeting place of the Philippian church.
people.catholic: Lydia is the first recorded convert in Europe and a model of hospitality and of a woman whose heart the Lord opens to the Word. The baptism of her whole household (Acts 16:15) is among the New Testament passages the Church points to in the tradition of baptizing entire families, including children.
know: A seller of purple from Thyatira.
First recorded convert in Europe (Philippi).
Baptized with her household (Acts 16:15).
Hosted Paul and Silas after their release from prison (Acts 16:40).

people.name: Maacah
people.summary: Maacah, sister of Huppim and Shuppim, was the wife of Machir son of Manasseh and bore Peresh (1 Chr 7:15-16).

people.name: Maacah
people.summary: Maacah was the wife of Jeiel the father of Gibeon (1 Chr 8:29; 9:35).

people.name: Maacah
people.summary: Maacah, daughter of Talmai king of Geshur, bore David his sons Absalom and (by implication) Tamar.
know: A princess of Geshur
Mother of Absalom

people.name: Madai
people.summary: A son of Japheth listed in the Table of Nations as ancestor of a people.
know: Usually associated with the Medes

people.name: Magog
people.summary: A son of Japheth listed in the Table of Nations as ancestor of a people.
know: The name later stands for a distant hostile people (Ezek 38-39; Rev 20:8)

people.name: Maher-shalal-hash-baz
people.summary: Second named son of Isaiah, born to 'the prophetess'. His name ('swift is the spoil, speedy the plunder') announced that Assyria would plunder Damascus and Samaria before he could say 'my father'.
know: Longest personal name in the Bible.
Name was first written on a tablet before witnesses (Isa 8:1-2).
A sign that Syria and Israel, Ahaz's enemies, would fall to Assyria.

people.name: Mamre
people.summary: An Amorite chief allied with Abram who went with him to rescue Lot and received a share of the spoil.
know: The oaks of Mamre near Hebron, where Abraham lived and received the three visitors, bear his name (Gen 13:18; 18:1)

people.name: Manahath
people.summary: Son of Shobal in the genealogy of Seir the Horite (Gen 36:23; 1 Chr 1:40).

people.name: Mash
people.summary: Son of Aram in the genealogy of the Table of Nations (Gen 10:23; 1 Chr 1:17). 1 Chr 1:17 calls him Meshech.

people.name: Massa
people.summary: A son of Ishmael and ancestor of an Arabian tribe.
know: One of the twelve princes descended from Ishmael (Gen 25:16)

people.name: Matred
people.summary: Matred, 'the daughter of Mezahab', is the mother of Mehetabel, wife of King Hadar of Edom (Gen 36:39; 1 Chr 1:50).

people.name: Mattathias
people.summary: Mattathias, son of Amos, appears only in Luke's genealogy of Jesus, which runs from Joseph back through David's son Nathan to Adam; he is listed as the father of Joseph (Lk 3:25).
know: Named only in Luke's genealogy (Lk 3:25).
Son of Amos; father of Joseph.

people.name: Mattathias
people.summary: Mattathias, son of Semein, appears only in Luke's genealogy of Jesus, which runs from Joseph back through David's son Nathan to Adam; he is listed as the father of Maath (Lk 3:26).
know: Named only in Luke's genealogy (Lk 3:26).
Son of Semein; father of Maath.

people.name: Matthat
people.summary: Matthat, son of Levi, appears only in Luke's genealogy of Jesus, which runs from Joseph back through David's son Nathan to Adam; he is listed as the father of Heli (Lk 3:24).
know: Named only in Luke's genealogy (Lk 3:24).
Son of Levi; father of Heli.

people.name: Matthat
people.summary: Matthat, son of Levi, appears only in Luke's genealogy of Jesus, which runs from Joseph back through David's son Nathan to Adam; he is listed as the father of Jorim (Lk 3:29).
know: Named only in Luke's genealogy (Lk 3:29).
Son of Levi; father of Jorim.

people.name: Matthias
people.summary: After the death of Judas Iscariot, Peter led the 120 disciples in choosing a replacement from among those who had accompanied Jesus from his baptism to his ascension. Two were put forward, Joseph Barsabbas and Matthias; after prayer they cast lots, and the lot fell on Matthias, who was numbered with the eleven apostles.
people.catholic: The election of Matthias is the first act of the Church after the Ascension and shows that the apostolic office ('his office let another take', Acts 1:20) continues after its holder: the root of the doctrine of apostolic succession (CCC 861-862). Peter takes the initiative, an early sign of his primacy among the Twelve. The restoration of the number twelve signifies the Church as the new Israel of twelve tribes. Feast May 14.
know: Chosen by lot after prayer to replace Judas Iscariot.
Had to be a witness of Jesus' ministry from John's baptism to the Ascension (Acts 1:21-22).
His election made the Twelve complete again before Pentecost.
Feast May 14.

people.name: Medad
people.summary: Elder of Israel who, with Eldad, received the Spirit and prophesied in the camp, prompting Moses' wish that all the LORD's people were prophets.
people.catholic: See Eldad: their story is read as an image of the Spirit's freedom and the prophetic dignity of all God's people.
know: Prophesied in the camp with Eldad (Num 11:26-27).
Joshua's jealousy for Moses was gently rebuked.

people.name: Medan
people.summary: A son of Abraham by Keturah, sent away eastward with gifts.
know: Son of Abraham and Keturah (Gen 25:2)

people.name: Mehetabel
people.summary: Mehetabel daughter of Matred was the wife of Hadar, king of Edom (Gen 36:39; 1 Chr 1:50).

people.name: Melchi
people.summary: Melchi, son of Jannai, appears only in Luke's genealogy of Jesus, which runs from Joseph back through David's son Nathan to Adam; he is listed as the father of Levi (Lk 3:24).
know: Named only in Luke's genealogy (Lk 3:24).
Son of Jannai; father of Levi.

people.name: Melchi
people.summary: Melchi, son of Addi, appears only in Luke's genealogy of Jesus, which runs from Joseph back through David's son Nathan to Adam; he is listed as the father of Neri (Lk 3:28).
know: Named only in Luke's genealogy (Lk 3:28).
Son of Addi; father of Neri.

people.name: Melech
people.summary: Son of Mica in the genealogy of Benjamin, house of Saul (1 Chr 8:35; 9:41).

people.name: Memucan
people.summary: One of the king's princes who advised deposing Vashti lest wives everywhere despise their husbands.
know: His advice led to Vashti's removal (Est 1:16-21).

people.name: Mephibosheth son of Saul
people.summary: This Mephibosheth, son of Saul and Rizpah, was executed by the Gibeonites; he is distinct from Jonathan's lame son of the same name.
know: Not Jonathan's son Mephibosheth

people.name: Merari
people.summary: The father of Judith, of the tribe of Simeon, named at the head of her long genealogy.
know: Not the Levite Merari son of Levi.
Judith is 'the daughter of Merari' in her own song (Jdt 16:7).

people.name: Mered
people.summary: Mered son of Ezrah, of Judah, married Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh as well as a Judahite wife; both bore him sons (1 Chr 4:17-18).

people.name: Merodach-baladan
people.summary: Merodach-baladan (Berodach Baladan) son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent envoys and a gift to the recovered Hezekiah, who showed them all his treasures - prompting Isaiah's prophecy that everything would be carried to Babylon.
know: Chaldean rebel king against Assyria
Called Berodach Baladan in 2 Kings

people.name: Mibsam
people.summary: A son of Ishmael and ancestor of an Arabian tribe.
know: One of the twelve princes descended from Ishmael (Gen 25:16)

people.name: Micah
people.summary: Micah of Moresheth, a contemporary of Isaiah, prophesied under Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah against the injustice of Samaria and Jerusalem, foretelling that Zion would be ploughed like a field. He also announced a ruler from little Bethlehem Ephrathah and summed up true religion: 'to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God'.
people.catholic: The chief priests and scribes cited Micah 5:2 to Herod as the prophecy that the Messiah would be born in Bethlehem (Mt 2:5-6); the Church reads 'she who is in labour gives birth' (Mic 5:3) of the Virgin Mary, and Mic 5 is read on the Fourth Sunday of Advent (Year C). The 'Reproaches' (Improperia) of the Good Friday liturgy — 'My people, what have I done to you?' — echo Micah 6:3.
know: From Moresheth in Judah; contemporary of Isaiah.
Bethlehem prophecy (Mic 5:2), quoted in Mt 2:6.
'Act justly, love mercy, walk humbly' (Mic 6:8).
His warning to Hezekiah was remembered at Jeremiah's trial (Jer 26:18-19).

people.name: Micaiah son of Gemariah
people.summary: Micaiah heard Baruch read Jeremiah's scroll and reported its words to the princes gathered in the scribe's chamber.
know: Grandson of Shaphan the scribe.

people.name: Michael
people.summary: Son of Abihail in the genealogy of Gad (1 Chr 5:13-14).

people.name: Mishael
people.summary: Son of Uzziel and cousin of Aaron. At Moses' command he and Elzaphan carried their kinsmen Nadab and Abihu out of the camp after the LORD's fire consumed them.
know: Son of Uzziel (Exo 6:22).
Carried Nadab and Abihu's bodies from the sanctuary (Lev 10:4-5).
Not the Mishael of Daniel.

people.name: Mishma
people.summary: Son of Mibsam in the genealogy of Simeon (1 Chr 4:25-26).

people.name: Mishma
people.summary: A son of Ishmael and ancestor of an Arabian tribe.
know: One of the twelve princes descended from Ishmael (Gen 25:16)

people.name: Naarah
people.summary: Naarah was one of the two wives of Ashhur the father of Tekoa; she bore Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni and Haahashtari (1 Chr 4:5-6).

people.name: Nadab
people.summary: Son of Shammai in the genealogy of Judah, among the Jerahmeelites (1 Chr 2:28; 2:30).

people.name: Nadab
people.summary: Son of Jeiel and Maacah in the genealogy of Benjamin, house of Saul (1 Chr 8:30; 9:36).

people.name: Naphish
people.summary: A son of Ishmael and ancestor of an Arabian tribe.
know: One of the twelve princes descended from Ishmael (Gen 25:16)

people.name: Neariah
people.summary: Son of Shemaiah in the genealogy of the royal line of David (1 Chr 3:22; 3:23).

people.name: Noadiah
people.summary: A prophetess who, with other prophets, tried to frighten Nehemiah into abandoning the work.
know: One of the few named women prophets in the Old Testament — here a hostile one.

people.name: Nogah
people.summary: Nogah was a son of David born in Jerusalem, listed only in Chronicles.
know: Listed only in Chronicles

people.name: Obadiah
people.summary: Son of Azel in the genealogy of Benjamin, house of Saul (1 Chr 8:38; 9:44).

people.name: Obadiah
people.summary: Son of Shemaiah in the genealogy of the Levites who resettled Jerusalem (1 Chr 9:16; Neh 11:17).

people.name: Obal
people.summary: Son of Joktan in the genealogy of the Table of Nations (Gen 10:28; 1 Chr 1:22).

people.name: Obed
people.summary: Son of Ephlal in the genealogy of Judah, among the Jerahmeelites (1 Chr 2:37-38).

people.name: Ohad
people.summary: A son of Simeon who went down to Egypt with Jacob's household.
know: Listed among the seventy of Jacob's house who came to Egypt (Gen 46)

people.name: Onam
people.summary: Son of Shobal in the genealogy of Seir the Horite (Gen 36:23; 1 Chr 1:40).

people.name: Onam
people.summary: Son of Jerahmeel and Atarah in the genealogy of Judah, among the Jerahmeelites (1 Chr 2:26; 2:28).

people.name: Onesimus
people.summary: Onesimus was a slave of Philemon at Colossae who left his master and came to Paul in prison, where Paul became his father in the faith. Paul sent him back with the Letter to Philemon, asking Philemon to receive him 'no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother', and offering to repay anything he owed. Colossians calls him 'the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you'.
people.catholic: The Letter to Philemon shows how communion in Christ transforms social relations; the Catechism cites Paul's request that the Christian master treat his Christian slave 'no longer as a slave but... as a brother' in teaching that enslaving human beings is a sin against their dignity (CCC 2414). His name means 'useful', and Paul plays on it (Philem 11). An Onesimus was bishop of Ephesus in the time of St Ignatius of Antioch, and some identify him with this Onesimus; this is possible but not certain.
know: A slave of Philemon; his name means 'useful' (Philem 10-11).
Converted by Paul during Paul's imprisonment.
Sent back to Philemon as a 'beloved brother' (Philem 16).
Travelled with Tychicus to Colossae (Col 4:9).

people.name: Onesiphorus
people.summary: Onesiphorus often refreshed Paul and was not ashamed of his chains; when he came to Rome he searched diligently until he found the imprisoned apostle, and he had served much at Ephesus. Paul prays mercy on his household and on him.
people.catholic: Paul prays that the Lord grant Onesiphorus mercy 'in that day' (2 Tim 1:18) while greeting only his household (2 Tim 4:19); many Catholic interpreters infer that he had died, making this a New Testament example of prayer for the dead (cf. CCC 1032). The text does not state that he had died.
know: Sought out and found Paul in prison at Rome (2 Tim 1:17).
Paul prays mercy for him 'in that day' (2 Tim 1:18).
Paul greets 'the house of Onesiphorus' (2 Tim 4:19).

people.name: Ophir
people.summary: Son of Joktan in the genealogy of the Table of Nations (Gen 10:29; 1 Chr 1:23).

people.name: Orpah
people.summary: Moabite widow of Chilion who set out with Naomi but, at Naomi's urging, kissed her and returned to her people and her gods.
people.catholic: Orpah's departure throws Ruth's fidelity into relief; spiritual writers contrast the two as the soul that turns back and the soul that clings to God.
know: Moabite wife of Chilion (Ruth 1:4; 4:10).
Kissed Naomi and turned back (Ruth 1:14-15).

people.name: Ozem
people.summary: Ozem is listed as Jesse's sixth son, David being the seventh.
know: Known only from the genealogy

people.name: Paltiel
people.summary: Paltiel (Palti) son of Laish received Michal from Saul; when she was taken back to David he followed her weeping as far as Bahurim.
know: Wept as Michal was taken from him

people.name: Pashhur son of Malchijah
people.summary: Pashhur son of Malchijah was sent by King Zedekiah to ask Jeremiah about Nebuchadnezzar's attack, and later was among the officials who demanded Jeremiah's death and had him lowered into the cistern of Malchijah.
know: Different from Pashhur son of Immer (Jer 20).

people.name: Pedaiah
people.summary: Pedaiah son of Jehoiachin is named in the Hebrew text of 1 Chr 3:19 as the father of Zerubbabel, whereas Ezra, Haggai and the Gospels call Zerubbabel 'son of Shealtiel'.
know: Possible explanations: levirate marriage, or Zerubbabel was Shealtiel's legal heir

people.name: Pelatiah son of Benaiah
people.summary: Pelatiah was one of twenty-five leaders Ezekiel saw in vision at the Temple's east gate giving wicked counsel; as Ezekiel prophesied against them, Pelatiah fell dead.
know: His death moved Ezekiel to cry out for the remnant of Israel (Ezek 11:13).

people.name: Peninnah
people.summary: Peninnah was Elkanah's second wife, who had children and provoked the childless Hannah year after year at Shiloh.
know: Elkanah's other wife
Taunted Hannah for her barrenness

people.name: Philip, first husband of Herodias
people.summary: The Gospels call Herodias 'his brother Philip's wife' (Mt 14:3; Mk 6:17): this Philip, a son of Herod the Great, was her first husband before she left him for Herod Antipas.
know: Josephus calls Herodias's first husband Herod (often called Herod II or 'Herod Philip'), a son of Herod the Great who held no territory.
Most scholars distinguish him from Philip the tetrarch of Luke 3:1.
Father of Salome according to Josephus.

people.name: Pithon
people.summary: Son of Mica in the genealogy of Benjamin, house of Saul (1 Chr 8:35; 9:41).

people.name: Publius
people.summary: Publius, the chief man of Malta, received Paul and the shipwrecked company for three days. Paul prayed, laid his hands on Publius' father, who lay sick with fever and dysentery, and healed him; many others on the island were then healed.
people.catholic: Tradition holds that Publius became the first bishop of Malta. Paul's prayer with the laying on of hands for the sick connects with the Church's ministry of healing.
know: Chief man of Malta (Acts 28:7).
His father was healed by Paul (Acts 28:8).

people.name: Purah
people.summary: Gideon's servant, who went down with him at night to the Midianite camp, where they overheard a soldier's dream of a barley loaf overturning a tent.
know: Gideon's servant (Jdg 7:10).
Overheard the dream of the barley loaf with Gideon.

people.name: Put
people.summary: A son of Ham, ancestor of a people usually located in Africa (often Libya).
know: Usually associated with Libya

people.name: Puvah
people.summary: A son of Issachar who went down to Egypt with Jacob's household.
know: Listed among the seventy of Jacob's house who came to Egypt (Gen 46)

people.name: Raamah
people.summary: Son of Cush in the genealogy of the Table of Nations (Gen 10:7; 1 Chr 1:9).

people.name: Raphah
people.summary: Son of Binea in the genealogy of Benjamin, house of Saul (1 Chr 8:37; 9:43).

people.name: Reaiah
people.summary: Son of Shobal in the genealogy of Judah, house of Hur (1 Chr 4:2; 2:52).

people.name: Reba
people.summary: One of the five kings (princes) of Midian killed by Israel in the war of vengeance for Peor, in which Balaam was also slain; Joshua 13:21 calls them princes of Sihon.
know: One of the five kings of Midian (Num 31:8).
Killed in Israel's war against Midian.

people.name: Rekem
people.summary: Son of Hebron in the genealogy of Judah, among the Calebites (1 Chr 2:43; 2:44).

people.name: Rekem
people.summary: One of the five kings (princes) of Midian killed by Israel in the war of vengeance for Peor, in which Balaam was also slain; Joshua 13:21 calls them princes of Sihon.
know: One of the five kings of Midian (Num 31:8).
Killed in Israel's war against Midian.

people.name: Riphath
people.summary: Son of Gomer in the genealogy of the Table of Nations (Gen 10:3; 1 Chr 1:6).

people.name: Rufus
people.summary: Paul greets Rufus, 'the chosen in the Lord', and his mother, who had been a mother to Paul as well.
people.catholic: Many interpreters suggest he is the Rufus whom Mark names as a son of Simon of Cyrene, who carried Jesus' cross (Mark 15:21), but this cannot be proven.
know: 'Chosen in the Lord' (Rom 16:13).
His mother had been like a mother to Paul.
Possibly the son of Simon of Cyrene (Mark 15:21).

people.name: Sabtah
people.summary: Son of Cush in the genealogy of the Table of Nations (Gen 10:7; 1 Chr 1:9).

people.name: Sabteca
people.summary: Son of Cush in the genealogy of the Table of Nations (Gen 10:7; 1 Chr 1:9).

people.name: Sallu
people.summary: Sallu son of Meshullam was a Benjamite head who resettled Jerusalem after the exile (1 Chr 9:7); Neh 11:7 gives his ancestry through Joed instead of Hodaviah.

people.name: Salma
people.summary: Son of Hur in the genealogy of Judah, house of Hur (1 Chr 2:51; 2:54). Called 'the father of Bethlehem'; distinct from Salma (Salmon) the father of Boaz.

people.name: Salome, daughter of Herodias
people.summary: The 'daughter of Herodias' danced at Herod Antipas's birthday feast and so pleased him that he swore to give her whatever she asked; prompted by her mother, she asked for the head of John the Baptist on a platter.
know: The Gospels do not name her; the name Salome comes from the historian Josephus.
Josephus says she later married Philip the tetrarch.
Distinct from Salome the disciple at the cross (Mk 15:40).

people.name: Salu
people.summary: Simeonite, father of Zimri.
know: Father of Zimri (Num 25:14).

people.name: Seba
people.summary: Son of Cush in the genealogy of the Table of Nations (Gen 10:7; 1 Chr 1:9).

people.name: Segub
people.summary: Son of Hezron and Daughter of Machir in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 2:21-22).

people.name: Seraiah
people.summary: Seraiah son of Kenaz, brother of the judge Othniel, was the father of Joab 'the father of Ge-harashim', a valley of craftsmen (1 Chr 4:13-14).

people.name: Seraiah son of Neriah
people.summary: Seraiah, Baruch's brother, was the chief quartermaster who travelled with King Zedekiah to Babylon. Jeremiah gave him a scroll of oracles against Babylon to read there, tie to a stone and sink in the Euphrates as a sign that Babylon would sink and not rise.
know: Brother of Baruch.
Performed Jeremiah's sign-act of sinking the scroll in the Euphrates (Jer 51:59-64).

people.name: Sered
people.summary: A son of Zebulun who went down to Egypt with Jacob's household.
know: Listed among the seventy of Jacob's house who came to Egypt (Gen 46)

people.name: Seron
people.summary: Commander of the army of Syria routed by Judas at the ascent of Beth-horon.
know: Judas: 'victory in battle stands not in the multitude of an army' (1 Macc 3:19).

people.name: Shallum
people.summary: Son of Sismai in the genealogy of Judah, among the Jerahmeelites (1 Chr 2:40-41).

people.name: Shallum son of Tikvah
people.summary: Shallum son of Tikvah, keeper of the wardrobe, was the husband of Huldah the prophetess.
know: Husband of Huldah

people.name: Shallum son of Zadok
people.summary: Shallum son of Zadok is listed in the high-priestly line of Eleazar son of Aaron in 1 Chronicles 6.
know: Part of the Aaronic line from Eleazar to the Exile

people.name: Shamgar
people.summary: Son of Anath, who struck down six hundred Philistines with an ox goad and also saved Israel. The Song of Deborah dates the perilous days when the highways were deserted to 'the days of Shamgar'.
know: Killed 600 Philistines with an ox goad (Jdg 3:31).
Named in the Song of Deborah (Jdg 5:6).

people.name: Shammai
people.summary: Son of Onam in the genealogy of Judah, among the Jerahmeelites (1 Chr 2:28; 2:32).

people.name: Shammai
people.summary: Son of Rekem in the genealogy of Judah, among the Calebites (1 Chr 2:44-45).

people.name: Sharezer
people.summary: Sharezer, son of Sennacherib, killed his father with Adrammelech and fled to Ararat.
know: Patricide

people.name: Shashak
people.summary: Son of Beriah in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:14; 8:25).

people.name: Sheariah
people.summary: Son of Azel in the genealogy of Benjamin, house of Saul (1 Chr 8:38; 9:44).

people.name: Sheba
people.summary: Son of Raamah in the genealogy of the Table of Nations (Gen 10:7; 1 Chr 1:9).

people.name: Sheba
people.summary: Son of Joktan in the genealogy of the Table of Nations (Gen 10:28; 1 Chr 1:22).

people.name: Sheba
people.summary: Son of Jokshan in the genealogy of Abraham's descendants through Keturah (Gen 25:3; 1 Chr 1:32).

people.name: Shecaniah
people.summary: Shecaniah heads one of the families of the post-exilic line of David; his son was Shemaiah (1 Chr 3:21-22).

people.name: Sheleph
people.summary: Son of Joktan in the genealogy of the Table of Nations (Gen 10:26; 1 Chr 1:20).

people.name: Shema
people.summary: Son of Hebron in the genealogy of Judah, among the Calebites (1 Chr 2:43; 2:44).

people.name: Shemaiah
people.summary: Shemaiah son of Hasshub, a Merarite Levite, resettled Jerusalem after the exile (1 Chr 9:14; Neh 11:15).

people.name: Shemaiah
people.summary: Son of Galal in the genealogy of the Levites who resettled Jerusalem (1 Chr 9:16; Neh 11:17).

people.name: Shephatiah
people.summary: Shephatiah was David's fifth son, born of Abital at Hebron.
know: Born at Hebron

people.name: Shepho
people.summary: Son of Shobal in the genealogy of Seir the Horite (Gen 36:23; 1 Chr 1:40).

people.name: Shillem
people.summary: A son of Naphtali who went down to Egypt with Jacob's household.
know: Listed among the seventy of Jacob's house who came to Egypt (Gen 46)

people.name: Shimeah
people.summary: Son of Mikloth in the genealogy of Benjamin, house of Saul (1 Chr 8:32; 9:38).

people.name: Shimei
people.summary: Son of Zaccur in the genealogy of Simeon (1 Chr 4:26-27). He had sixteen sons and six daughters.

people.name: Shimei
people.summary: Son of Gershon and grandson of Levi, listed in the Levitical genealogies; head of a Levite clan.
know: Grandson of Levi through Gershon.
Named in the genealogy of Exodus 6 and the census of Numbers 3.

people.name: Shomer
people.summary: Son of Heber in the genealogy of Asher (1 Chr 7:32; 7:34).

people.name: Shua's daughter (Bath-shua)
people.summary: The Canaanite daughter of Shua whom Judah married; she bore Er, Onan and Shelah and died before the events with Tamar. Her personal name is not given; 1 Chr 2:3 in Hebrew reads 'Bath-shua', 'daughter of Shua'.
know: Mother of Er, Onan and Shelah (Gen 38:3-5)
Died before Judah went to Timnah (Gen 38:12)

people.name: Shuah
people.summary: A son of Abraham by Keturah, sent away eastward with gifts.
know: Son of Abraham and Keturah (Gen 25:2)

people.name: Shuni
people.summary: A son of Gad who went down to Egypt with Jacob's household.
know: Listed among the seventy of Jacob's house who came to Egypt (Gen 46)

people.name: Simeon
people.role: Righteous man who received the Christ child
people.summary: Simeon, a righteous and devout man of Jerusalem awaiting the consolation of Israel, had been told by the Holy Spirit he would not die before seeing the Lord's Christ. When Mary and Joseph presented Jesus in the Temple, he took the child in his arms, blessed God, and foretold that Jesus would be a sign spoken against and that a sword would pierce Mary's soul.
people.catholic: Simeon's canticle, the Nunc Dimittis ('Now, Lord, you let your servant go in peace', Lk 2:29-32), is prayed every night at Night Prayer (Compline). At the Presentation (February 2) he recognizes Jesus as 'a light for revelation to the Gentiles', which gives the feast its candle blessing (Candlemas). The Church sees in the Presentation Christ's first offering of himself (CCC 529), and his prophecy is the first of the Seven Sorrows of Mary.
know: Promised he would see the Christ before death (Lk 2:26).
Took the infant Jesus in his arms in the Temple (Lk 2:28).
Spoke the Nunc Dimittis (Lk 2:29-32).
Prophesied the sword that would pierce Mary's soul (Lk 2:35).

people.name: Simon the leper
people.summary: In the house of Simon the leper at Bethany, a woman poured costly ointment on Jesus' head; Jesus defended her, saying she had anointed his body beforehand for burial.
know: His house at Bethany was the scene of the anointing before the Passion (Mt 26:6; Mk 14:3).
John places the Bethany anointing at the home of Lazarus, Martha and Mary (Jn 12:1-3).
Distinct in the text from Simon the Pharisee (Lk 7).

people.name: Simon, 'brother of the Lord'
people.summary: Simon is listed among the 'brothers' of Jesus by the people of Nazareth (Mt 13:55; Mk 6:3).
people.catholic: As with James and Joses, the Church understands Simon as a kinsman of Jesus, not a son of Mary (CCC 500). Tradition (Hegesippus, in Eusebius) speaks of Symeon son of Clopas, a cousin of the Lord who became the second bishop of Jerusalem and was martyred under Trajan; many identify him with this Simon, though this is not certain.
know: One of four 'brothers' named at Nazareth (Mk 6:3).
Possibly the Symeon son of Clopas whom Tradition makes second bishop of Jerusalem.
Distinct from Simon Peter and Simon the Zealot in Scripture.

relations.type: by Tradition, son of (if identified with Symeon of Jerusalem)

people.name: Sosthenes
people.summary: Sosthenes, ruler of the synagogue at Corinth, was seized and beaten before Gallio's judgment seat after the failed case against Paul. A 'brother Sosthenes' is co-sender of 1 Corinthians.
know: Beaten before Gallio (Acts 18:17).
Possibly the same as the 'brother Sosthenes' of 1 Cor 1:1, though this is not certain.

people.name: Tahath
people.summary: Son of Assir in the genealogy of Levi, among the Kohathites (1 Chr 6:24; 6:37).

people.name: Tarea
people.summary: Son of Mica in the genealogy of Benjamin, house of Saul (1 Chr 8:35; 9:41).

people.name: Tarshish
people.summary: Son of Javan in the genealogy of the Table of Nations (Gen 10:4; 1 Chr 1:7).

people.name: Tema
people.summary: A son of Ishmael and ancestor of an Arabian tribe.
know: One of the twelve princes descended from Ishmael (Gen 25:16)

people.name: Tertullus
people.summary: Tertullus was the orator who presented the high priest's case against Paul before Felix, flattering the governor and calling Paul 'a pest' and 'a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes'.
know: Advocate for the high priest Ananias (Acts 24:1).
Called Paul 'a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes' (Acts 24:5).

people.name: Theophilus
people.summary: Theophilus is the 'most excellent' person to whom Luke dedicates his Gospel and the Acts of the Apostles, so that he may know the certainty of what he has been taught.
people.catholic: His title suggests a person of rank, perhaps Luke's patron. Since the name means 'friend of God', the Fathers (e.g. St Ambrose) also read it as addressing every reader who loves God.
know: Addressed in Luke 1:3 and Acts 1:1.
His name means 'friend of God'.
Addressee of Luke 1:3 and Acts 1:1.
Name means 'friend of God' or 'loved by God'.
Called 'most excellent', a title of rank.

people.name: Tibni
people.summary: Tibni son of Ginath was backed by half of Israel as king against Omri; after some years of civil war Tibni died and Omri reigned alone.
know: Rival of Omri

people.name: Tidal
people.summary: Tidal, king of Goiim, was one of the four eastern kings who warred against the cities of the plain and carried off Lot; Abram defeated them.
know: One of the 'four kings against the five' (Gen 14:9)

people.name: Tiras
people.summary: A son of Japheth listed in the Table of Nations as ancestor of a people.
know: Listed last among Japheth's sons

people.name: Tirhakah
people.summary: Tirhakah king of Ethiopia (Cush) marched out against Sennacherib during the siege of Jerusalem.
know: Cushite pharaoh of Egypt's 25th dynasty

people.name: Togarmah
people.summary: Son of Gomer in the genealogy of the Table of Nations (Gen 10:3; 1 Chr 1:6).

people.name: Tubal
people.summary: A son of Japheth listed in the Table of Nations as ancestor of a people.
know: Associated with a people of Asia Minor

people.name: Ulam
people.summary: Son of Sheresh in the genealogy of Manasseh (1 Chr 7:16-17).

people.name: Ulam
people.summary: Ulam, firstborn of Eshek, headed a family of valiant Benjamite archers with 150 sons and grandsons - the last generation of Saul's line recorded (1 Chr 8:39-40).

people.name: Uz
people.summary: Son of Aram in the genealogy of the Table of Nations (Gen 10:23; 1 Chr 1:17). 1 Chronicles lists him directly among the sons of Shem.

people.name: Uz
people.summary: Son of Dishan in the genealogy of Seir the Horite (Gen 36:28; 1 Chr 1:42).

people.name: Uzal
people.summary: Son of Joktan in the genealogy of the Table of Nations (Gen 10:27; 1 Chr 1:21).

people.name: Uzzi
people.summary: Son of Tola in the genealogy of Issachar (1 Chr 7:2; 7:3).

people.name: Zaavan
people.summary: Son of Ezer in the genealogy of Seir the Horite (Gen 36:27; 1 Chr 1:42).

people.name: Zabad
people.summary: Son of Nathan in the genealogy of Judah, among the Jerahmeelites (1 Chr 2:36-37).

people.name: Zecher
people.summary: Son of Jeiel and Maacah in the genealogy of Benjamin, house of Saul (1 Chr 8:31; 9:37).

people.name: Zerah of Bozrah
people.summary: Zerah of Bozrah is the father of Jobab, the second king of Edom (Gen 36:33; 1 Chr 1:44).

people.name: Zibiah
people.summary: Zibiah of Beersheba was the mother of King Joash (Jehoash) of Judah.
know: From Beersheba

people.name: Zichri
people.summary: Son of Asaph in the genealogy of the Levites who resettled Jerusalem (1 Chr 9:15; Neh 11:17).

people.name: Zimmah
people.summary: Son of Jahath in the genealogy of Levi, among the Gershonites (1 Chr 6:20).

people.name: Zimran
people.summary: A son of Abraham by Keturah, sent away eastward with gifts.
know: Son of Abraham and Keturah (Gen 25:2)

people.name: Zimri
people.summary: Son of Jehoaddah in the genealogy of Benjamin, house of Saul (1 Chr 8:36; 9:42).

people.name: Zimri
people.summary: Son of Salu and a prince of the tribe of Simeon, who during the apostasy at Baal Peor brought the Midianite woman Cozbi into his tent in the sight of Moses and the congregation; Phinehas killed them both and the plague stopped.
know: Son of Salu, a leader of Simeon (Num 25:14).
Killed by Phinehas with Cozbi.
Recalled in 1 Mac 2:26.

people.name: Zohar (father of Ephron)
people.summary: Father of Ephron the Hittite.
know: Not the same as Zohar son of Simeon

people.name: Zohar (son of Simeon)
people.summary: A son of Simeon who went down to Egypt with Jacob's household.
know: Listed among the seventy of Jacob's house who came to Egypt (Gen 46)
Called Zerah in Num 26:13

people.name: Zophah
people.summary: Son of Hotham in the genealogy of Asher (1 Chr 7:35; 7:36).

people.name: Zur
people.summary: Son of Jeiel and Maacah in the genealogy of Benjamin, house of Saul (1 Chr 8:30; 9:36).

people.name: Abdi
people.summary: Son of Malluch in the genealogy of Levi, among the Merarites (1 Chr 6:44). In the ancestry of Ethan the singer.

people.name: Abdiel
people.summary: Son of Guni in the genealogy of Gad (1 Chr 5:15).

people.name: Abdon
people.summary: Son of Shashak in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:23; 8:25).

people.name: Abiasaph
people.summary: Abiasaph was a son of Korah listed in the Levitical genealogy of Exodus 6; the line of Korah survived the rebellion and later supplied temple singers.
know: Son of Korah (Exo 6:24).
Ancestor of a Korahite family.
Korah's sons did not die in the rebellion (Num 26:11).

people.name: Abihail
people.summary: Abihail was the wife of Abishur of the Jerahmeelite clan and bore him Ahban and Molid (1 Chr 2:29).

people.name: Abihail
people.summary: Son of Huri in the genealogy of Gad (1 Chr 5:14; 5:13).

people.name: Abihud
people.summary: Son of Bela in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:3).

people.name: Abijah
people.summary: Abijah, wife of Hezron, bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa after Hezron's death (1 Chr 2:24).

people.name: Abijah
people.summary: Son of Becher in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 7:8).

people.name: Abijah son of Jeroboam
people.summary: Abijah, Jeroboam's young son, fell sick; his mother went in disguise to the blind prophet Ahijah, who foretold the child's death - the only one of Jeroboam's house to be mourned and buried, 'because in him there is found some good thing toward the LORD'.
know: The only good found in Jeroboam's house

people.name: Abijah son of Samuel
people.summary: Abijah, Samuel's second son, judged with his brother Joel at Beersheba and, like him, took bribes.
know: His corruption helped prompt Israel's request for a king

people.name: Abishua
people.summary: Son of Bela in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:4).

people.name: Abitub
people.summary: Son of Shaharaim and Hushim in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:11).

people.name: Abiud
people.summary: Abiud, son of Zerubbabel, appears only in Matthew's genealogy of Jesus as the father of Eliakim (Mt 1:13), in the line of David's royal heirs after the Babylonian exile.
people.catholic: Matthew arranges these generations into three sets of fourteen (Mt 1:17), presenting Jesus as the heir of Abraham and of David's royal house through his legal father Joseph.
know: Named only in Matthew 1 - a link in Jesus' royal Davidic line after the exile.
Son of Zerubbabel; father of Eliakim.

people.name: Achaicus
people.summary: Achaicus came to Paul from Corinth with Stephanas and Fortunatus, refreshing Paul's spirit and supplying what the Corinthians lacked.
know: Visited Paul with Stephanas (1 Cor 16:17).

people.name: Achim
people.summary: Achim, son of Zadok, appears only in Matthew's genealogy of Jesus as the father of Eliud (Mt 1:14), in the line of David's royal heirs after the Babylonian exile.
know: Named only in Matthew 1 - a link in Jesus' royal Davidic line after the exile.
Son of Zadok; father of Eliud.

people.name: Adaiah
people.summary: Son of Ethan in the genealogy of Levi, among the Gershonites (1 Chr 6:41-42). In the ancestry of Asaph the singer.

people.name: Adaiah
people.summary: Son of Shimei in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:21).

people.name: Adaiah
people.summary: Son of Joiarib in the genealogy of Judah, among those who settled in Jerusalem under Nehemiah (Neh 11:5).

people.name: Addar
people.summary: Son of Bela in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:3).

people.name: Addi
people.summary: Addi, son of Cosam, appears only in Luke's genealogy of Jesus, which runs from Joseph back through David's son Nathan to Adam; he is listed as the father of Melchi (Lk 3:28).
know: Named only in Luke's genealogy (Lk 3:28).
Son of Cosam; father of Melchi.

people.name: Adiel
people.summary: Son of Jahzerah in the genealogy of the priests who resettled Jerusalem (1 Chr 9:12).

people.name: Agur son of Jakeh
people.summary: The otherwise unknown sage to whom Proverbs 30 is attributed, who confesses his ignorance of the Holy One and asks God for 'neither poverty nor riches'.
people.catholic: Agur's question 'What is his name, and what is his son's name?' (Prov 30:4) has long been read by Christians as a veiled pointer to the Son of God. His prayer for 'neither poverty nor riches' (Prov 30:8-9) is a classic of Christian teaching on detachment and daily bread.
know: Author of Proverbs 30.
Era unknown; placed here with the wisdom tradition.

people.name: Aharah
people.summary: Son of Benjamin in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:1).

people.name: Aharhel
people.summary: Son of Harum in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 4:8).

people.name: Ahban
people.summary: Son of Abishur and Abihail in the genealogy of Judah, among the Jerahmeelites (1 Chr 2:29).

people.name: Ahi
people.summary: Son of Abdiel in the genealogy of Gad (1 Chr 5:15). Chief of the Gadite fathers' houses.

people.name: Ahi
people.summary: Son of Shomer in the genealogy of Asher (1 Chr 7:34).

people.name: Ahian
people.summary: Son of Shemida in the genealogy of Manasseh (1 Chr 7:19).

people.name: Ahijah
people.summary: Son of Jerahmeel in the genealogy of Judah, among the Jerahmeelites (1 Chr 2:25).

people.name: Ahimoth
people.summary: Son of Elkanah in the genealogy of Levi, among the Kohathites (1 Chr 6:25).

people.name: Ahinoam daughter of Ahimaaz
people.summary: Ahinoam daughter of Ahimaaz is the only named wife of King Saul.
know: Not the same as David's wife Ahinoam of Jezreel

people.name: Ahio
people.summary: Son of Beriah in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:14).

people.name: Ahishahar
people.summary: Son of Bilhan in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 7:10).

people.name: Ahlai
people.summary: Ahlai is listed as Sheshan's child (1 Chr 2:31); since Sheshan 'had no sons, but only daughters' (2:34), Ahlai may be a daughter.

people.name: Ahoah
people.summary: Son of Bela in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:4).

people.name: Ahumai
people.summary: Son of Jahath in the genealogy of Judah, house of Hur (1 Chr 4:2).

people.name: Ahuzzam
people.summary: Son of Ashhur and Naarah in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 4:6).

people.name: Ahuzzath
people.summary: Adviser ('friend') of Abimelech who came with him to make peace with Isaac.
know: Mentioned once (Gen 26:26)

people.name: Akkub
people.summary: Son of Elioenai in the genealogy of the royal line of David (1 Chr 3:24).

people.name: Alemeth
people.summary: Son of Becher in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 7:8).

people.name: Alexander (relative of the high priest)
people.summary: Alexander was one of the high-priestly family, with Annas, Caiaphas and John, who examined Peter and John after the healing of the lame man.
know: Sat with Annas and Caiaphas when Peter and John were questioned.

people.name: Alexander (with Hymenaeus)
people.summary: Alexander was handed over to Satan by Paul together with Hymenaeus, 'that they might be taught not to blaspheme', after they had made shipwreck of the faith.
know: Disciplined with Hymenaeus (1 Tim 1:20).
May be the same as Alexander the coppersmith (2 Tim 4:14); this is uncertain.

people.name: Alexander of Ephesus
people.summary: Alexander was put forward by the Jews during the Ephesian riot and tried to make a defense to the crowd, but they shouted him down for two hours when they recognized he was a Jew.
know: Shouted down in the Ephesian theater (Acts 19:33-34).

relations.type: caught up in the riot of

people.name: Alexander the coppersmith
people.summary: Alexander the coppersmith did Paul 'much evil' and strongly opposed his message; Paul warns Timothy to beware of him and leaves judgment to the Lord.
know: 'The Lord will repay him according to his deeds' (2 Tim 4:14).
Possibly the Alexander of 1 Tim 1:20; uncertain.

people.name: Alexander, son of Simon of Cyrene
people.summary: Alexander is named, with his brother Rufus, as a son of Simon of Cyrene (Mk 15:21), apparently because they were known to Mark's readers.
know: Son of Simon of Cyrene.
Brother of Rufus.

people.name: Allon
people.summary: Son of Jedaiah in the genealogy of Simeon (1 Chr 4:37).

people.name: Alphaeus, father of Levi
people.summary: Alphaeus is named once, as the father of Levi the tax collector (Mk 2:14), whom the other Gospels call Matthew.
know: Named only in Mark 2:14.
Whether he is the same Alphaeus as the father of James is not stated in Scripture.

people.name: Amal
people.summary: Son of Hotham in the genealogy of Asher (1 Chr 7:35).
