people.name: Aman (Nadab)
people.summary: The man whom Achiacharus raised but who betrayed him, 'bringing him out of light into darkness'; he himself fell into the snare and perished. In the wider Ahikar story he is called Nadan.
know: Not to be confused with Haman of Esther.
Cited by Tobit as a warning (Tob 14:10).

people.name: Amariah
people.summary: Son of Shephatiah in the genealogy of Judah, among those who settled in Jerusalem under Nehemiah (Neh 11:4).

people.name: Amariah son of Hezekiah
people.summary: Amariah, son of a Hezekiah, was the great-grandfather of the prophet Zephaniah.
know: Zeph 1:1 calls him 'son of Hezekiah' without saying 'king'; many think this is King Hezekiah of Judah, which would make Zephaniah of royal descent, but the text does not confirm it.

people.name: Amaziah
people.summary: Amaziah is named in the genealogy of Simeon (1 Chr 4:34).

people.name: Amaziah
people.summary: Son of Hilkiah in the genealogy of Levi, among the Merarites (1 Chr 6:45). In the ancestry of Ethan the singer.

people.name: Ammiel
people.summary: Son of Gemalli, the man of Dan among the twelve sent by Moses to scout Canaan. With nine others he brought back an 'evil report' that discouraged the people; those ten died by plague before the LORD.
know: Represented Dan among the twelve spies (Num 13).
Brought back a discouraging report.
Died by plague (Num 14:36-37).

people.name: Ammihud
people.summary: Son of Omri in the genealogy of Judah, among those who resettled Jerusalem (1 Chr 9:4).

people.name: Amnon
people.summary: Son of Shimon in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 4:20).

people.name: Amos
people.summary: Amos, son of Nahum, appears only in Luke's genealogy of Jesus, which runs from Joseph back through David's son Nathan to Adam; he is listed as the father of Mattathias (Lk 3:25).
know: Named only in Luke's genealogy (Lk 3:25).
Son of Nahum; father of Mattathias.

people.name: Amplias
people.summary: Amplias is named in the greetings of Paul's Letter to the Romans. 'My beloved in the Lord' (also called Ampliatus).
know: 'My beloved in the Lord' (also called Ampliatus).

people.name: Amzi
people.summary: Son of Bani in the genealogy of Levi, among the Merarites (1 Chr 6:46). In the ancestry of Ethan the singer.

people.name: Anael
people.summary: Tobit's brother and the father of Achiacharus (Ahikar).
know: Father of Achiacharus.

people.name: Anani
people.summary: Son of Elioenai in the genealogy of the royal line of David (1 Chr 3:24).

people.name: Anathoth
people.summary: Son of Becher in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 7:8).

people.name: Andronicus
people.summary: Andronicus, with Junia, was a relative and fellow prisoner of Paul, 'notable among the apostles', who had come to Christ before Paul.
people.catholic: With Junia he is honored as a saint; they are commonly regarded as a missionary couple. 'Apostles' here is generally understood in the wider sense of missionaries sent by the churches, distinct from the Twelve.
know: Greeted with Junia in Rom 16:7.
A believer before Paul's conversion.
Shared imprisonment with Paul.
Murdered Onias (2 Macc 4:34).
Executed by Antiochus (2 Macc 4:38).

people.name: Aniam
people.summary: Son of Shemida in the genealogy of Manasseh (1 Chr 7:19).

people.name: Anna
people.summary: Anna, a prophetess, daughter of Phanuel of the tribe of Asher, was a widow of great age who never left the Temple, worshipping with fasting and prayer night and day. Coming up at the Presentation, she gave thanks to God and spoke of the child to all who were looking for the redemption of Jerusalem.
people.catholic: With Simeon, Anna represents faithful Israel waiting for the Messiah and welcoming him at the Presentation (CCC 529). Her life of prayer and fasting in the Temple makes her a patroness of widows and of consecrated life.
know: Daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher (Lk 2:36).
A widow who served God in the Temple night and day (Lk 2:37).
Spoke of Jesus to all awaiting Jerusalem's redemption (Lk 2:38).

people.name: Anthothijah
people.summary: Son of Shashak in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:24; 8:25).

people.name: Antiochus III the Great
people.summary: 'Antiochus, the great king of Asia', who fought the Romans with 120 elephants and was defeated (Magnesia, 190 BC). Father of Seleucus IV and Antiochus IV.
know: Defeated by Rome (1 Macc 8:6-8).
Father of Antiochus IV (1 Macc 1:10).
Fatherhood of Seleucus IV is historical, not stated in Scripture.

people.name: Antipas
people.summary: Antipas is called by the risen Christ 'my witness, my faithful one, who was killed among you' in the letter to the church at Pergamum, 'where Satan's throne is'.
people.catholic: He is honored as a martyr; tradition holds that he was bishop of Pergamum. Christ's own title 'faithful witness' (Rev 1:5) is given to him, showing the martyr's share in Christ's witness.
know: Martyred at Pergamum (Rev 2:13).
Called 'my faithful witness' by Christ.

people.name: Anub
people.summary: Son of Hakkoz in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 4:8).

people.name: Apelles
people.summary: Apelles is named in the greetings of Paul's Letter to the Romans. 'The approved in Christ'.
know: 'The approved in Christ'.

people.name: Apphia
people.summary: Apphia, 'the beloved' (or 'our sister'), is greeted with Philemon and Archippus at the head of the Letter to Philemon.
know: Greeted in Philemon 2.
Often thought to be Philemon's wife; the text does not say.

people.name: Ara
people.summary: Son of Jether in the genealogy of Asher (1 Chr 7:38).

people.name: Arad
people.summary: Son of Beriah in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:15).

people.name: Arah
people.summary: Son of Ulla in the genealogy of Asher (1 Chr 7:39).

people.name: Aram
people.summary: Son of Shomer in the genealogy of Asher (1 Chr 7:34).

people.name: Archelaus
people.summary: Archelaus, son of Herod the Great, ruled Judea, Samaria and Idumea after his father's death (4 BC - AD 6) until Rome deposed him for misrule. Fearing him, Joseph withdrew with the child and Mary to Galilee and settled in Nazareth.
people.catholic: Many commentators see an echo of his journey to Rome to receive his kingdom, and the delegation sent against him, in Jesus' parable of the nobleman (Lk 19:12-14).
know: Son of Herod the Great (Mt 2:22).
His reign is why the Holy Family settled in Nazareth (Mt 2:22-23).
Deposed by Augustus in AD 6.

people.name: Ardon
people.summary: Son of Caleb in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 2:18).

people.name: Aretas
people.summary: King Aretas (Aretas IV of Nabataea) is mentioned by Paul: the governor under him in Damascus guarded the city to arrest Paul, who escaped by being let down through a window in a basket.
know: Paul's escape from Damascus in a basket (2 Cor 11:32-33; cf. Acts 9:23-25).

people.name: Aristobulus
people.summary: Aristobulus is named in the greetings of Paul's Letter to the Romans. Paul greets 'those who are of the household of Aristobulus'.
know: Paul greets 'those who are of the household of Aristobulus'.

people.name: Armoni
people.summary: Armoni, son of Saul and Rizpah, was handed to the Gibeonites and executed to atone for Saul's slaughter of Gibeon.
know: One of seven descendants of Saul executed at Gibeah

people.name: Arodi
people.summary: A son of Gad who went down to Egypt with Jacob's household.
know: Listed among the seventy of Jacob's house who came to Egypt (Gen 46)

people.name: Artemas
people.summary: Artemas was a co-worker whom Paul intended to send to Crete (or Tychicus instead) so that Titus could join him at Nicopolis.
know: Might relieve Titus in Crete (Titus 3:12).

people.name: Asa
people.summary: Son of Elkanah in the genealogy of the Levites who resettled Jerusalem (1 Chr 9:16).

people.name: Asarel
people.summary: Son of Jehallelel in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 4:16).

people.name: Ashpenaz
people.summary: Ashpenaz, master of Nebuchadnezzar's eunuchs, selected Daniel and his companions for training and gave them Babylonian names; God gave Daniel favour with him when Daniel asked not to defile himself with the king's food.
know: Gave Daniel the name Belteshazzar (Dan 1:7).

people.name: Ashvath
people.summary: Son of Japhlet in the genealogy of Asher (1 Chr 7:33).

people.name: Asiel
people.summary: Asiel is named in the genealogy of Simeon (1 Chr 4:35).

people.name: Assir
people.summary: Assir was a son of Korah listed in the Levitical genealogy of Exodus 6; the line of Korah survived the rebellion and later supplied temple singers.
know: Son of Korah (Exo 6:24).
Ancestor of a Korahite family.
Korah's sons did not die in the rebellion (Num 26:11).

people.name: Asyncritus
people.summary: Asyncritus is named in the greetings of Paul's Letter to the Romans. Greeted with Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas and Hermas.
know: Greeted with Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas and Hermas.

people.name: Atarah
people.summary: Atarah was the second wife of Jerahmeel son of Hezron and the mother of Onam (1 Chr 2:26).

people.name: Athaiah
people.summary: Athaiah son of Uzziah, of the children of Perez, was among the people of Judah who settled in Jerusalem in Nehemiah's day (Neh 11:4).

people.name: Athaliah
people.summary: Son of Jeroham in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:26; 8:27).

people.name: Azariah
people.summary: Son of Ethan in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 2:8).

people.name: Azariah
people.summary: Son of Zephaniah in the genealogy of Levi, among the Kohathites (1 Chr 6:36). In the ancestry of Samuel and Heman the singer.

people.name: Azaz
people.summary: Son of Shema in the genealogy of Reuben (1 Chr 5:8).

people.name: Azrikam
people.summary: Son of Neariah in the genealogy of the royal line of David (1 Chr 3:23).

people.name: Azzur
people.summary: Azzur of Gibeon was the father of the false prophet Hananiah.

people.name: Baal
people.summary: Son of Reaiah in the genealogy of Reuben (1 Chr 5:5).

people.name: Baalis
people.summary: Baalis, king of Ammon, sent Ishmael son of Nethaniah to assassinate Gedaliah.

people.name: Baara
people.summary: Baara was one of the wives whom Shaharaim the Benjamite sent away (1 Chr 8:8).

people.name: Baaseiah
people.summary: Son of Malchijah in the genealogy of Levi, among the Gershonites (1 Chr 6:40). In the ancestry of Asaph the singer.

people.name: Bani
people.summary: Son of Shemer in the genealogy of Levi, among the Merarites (1 Chr 6:46). In the ancestry of Ethan the singer.

people.name: Bani
people.summary: Bani is named in the genealogy of Judah, among those who resettled Jerusalem (1 Chr 9:4).

people.name: Bani
people.summary: Son of Hashabiah in the genealogy of the Levites who resettled Jerusalem (Neh 11:22).

people.name: Bariah
people.summary: Son of Shemaiah in the genealogy of the royal line of David (1 Chr 3:22).

people.name: Bartimaeus
people.summary: Bartimaeus, son of Timaeus, was a blind beggar at Jericho. Hearing that Jesus was passing, he cried out, 'Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!' and would not be silenced; throwing off his cloak he came to Jesus, received his sight, and followed him on the way.
people.catholic: His persistent cry joins the Gospel prayers of mercy that shaped the 'Jesus Prayer' and the Kyrie eleison. He confesses Jesus by the messianic title 'Son of David', and his following 'on the way' to Jerusalem makes him a model disciple.
know: Son of Timaeus (Mk 10:46).
Called Jesus 'Son of David' (Mk 10:47).
Healed at Jericho and followed Jesus (Mk 10:52).

people.name: Baruch
people.summary: Son of Colhozeh in the genealogy of Judah, among those who settled in Jerusalem under Nehemiah (Neh 11:5).

people.name: Basemath (daughter of Elon)
people.summary: Hittite wife of Esau, daughter of Elon, according to Gen 26:34.
know: Many interpreters identify her with Adah daughter of Elon (Gen 36:2)

people.name: Bedan
people.summary: Son of Ulam in the genealogy of Manasseh (1 Chr 7:17).

people.name: Beera
people.summary: Son of Zophah in the genealogy of Asher (1 Chr 7:37).

people.name: Beerah
people.summary: Beerah son of Baal, prince of the Reubenites, was carried into exile by Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria (1 Chr 5:6).

people.name: Beeri
people.summary: Beeri is named only as the father of the prophet Hosea.
know: Not the Beeri who was Esau's father-in-law.

people.name: Beeri the Hittite
people.summary: A Hittite, father of Esau's wife Judith.
know: Not Beeri the father of the prophet Hosea

people.name: Bela
people.summary: Bela son of Azaz, a Reubenite, lived in Aroer and grazed his herds eastward toward the Euphrates (1 Chr 5:8-9).

people.name: Ben Ammi
people.summary: Son of Lot by his younger daughter; ancestor of the Ammonites.
know: Name means 'son of my people'
Ancestor of the Ammonites (Gen 19:38)

people.name: Ben Hanan
people.summary: Son of Shimon in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 4:20).

people.name: Ben Zoheth
people.summary: Son of Ishi in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 4:20).

people.name: Benjamin
people.summary: Son of Bilhan in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 7:10).

people.name: Bera
people.summary: Bera, king of Sodom, was one of the five kings of the cities of the plain who rebelled against Chedorlaomer and were defeated in the valley of Siddim.
know: One of the five kings of the cities of the plain (Gen 14:2)
Abram refused to take even a sandal strap from the king of Sodom (Gen 14:22-23)

people.name: Beraiah
people.summary: Son of Shimei in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:21).

people.name: Berechiah
people.summary: Son of Zerubbabel in the genealogy of the royal line of David (1 Chr 3:20).

people.name: Berechiah
people.summary: Son of Asa in the genealogy of the Levites who resettled Jerusalem (1 Chr 9:16). He lived in the villages of the Netophathites.

people.name: Bered
people.summary: Son of Shuthelah in the genealogy of Ephraim (1 Chr 7:20).

people.name: Beri
people.summary: Son of Zophah in the genealogy of Asher (1 Chr 7:36).

people.name: Beriah
people.summary: Beriah was born to Ephraim after the death of Ezer and Elead and named 'because there was trouble with his house'; Joshua descends from his line (1 Chr 7:23-27).

people.name: Bezer
people.summary: Son of Zophah in the genealogy of Asher (1 Chr 7:37).

people.name: Bilhan
people.summary: Son of Jediael in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 7:10).

people.name: Bimhal
people.summary: Son of Japhlet in the genealogy of Asher (1 Chr 7:33).

people.name: Birsha
people.summary: Birsha, king of Gomorrah, was one of the five kings of the cities of the plain who rebelled against Chedorlaomer and were defeated in the valley of Siddim.
know: One of the five kings of the cities of the plain (Gen 14:2)

people.name: Bithiah
people.role: Daughter of Pharaoh, wife of Mered
people.summary: Bithiah, 'the daughter of Pharaoh', married Mered of Judah; the sons named in 1 Chr 4:17 are hers (1 Chr 4:17-18). Her name means 'daughter of the LORD'.

people.name: Blastus
people.summary: Blastus was the personal aide of King Herod Agrippa I, whom the people of Tyre and Sidon won over to ask the king for peace.
know: Chamberlain of Herod Agrippa I (Acts 12:20).

people.name: Bugathan
people.summary: The chamberlain who pointed out the gallows Haman had prepared for Mordecai, prompting the king to hang Haman on it (Harbonah in the Hebrew).
know: His remark sealed Haman's fate (Est 7:9).

people.name: Bunah
people.summary: Son of Jerahmeel in the genealogy of Judah, among the Jerahmeelites (1 Chr 2:25).

people.name: Bunni
people.summary: Bunni is named in the genealogy of the Levites who resettled Jerusalem (Neh 11:15).

people.name: Buz
people.summary: Buz is named in the genealogy of Gad (1 Chr 5:14).

people.name: Buz
people.summary: A son of Nahor, Abraham's brother, by Milcah.
know: Elihu in Job is called 'the Buzite' (Job 32:2)

people.name: Buzi
people.summary: Buzi was a priest and the father of the prophet Ezekiel.

people.name: Caesar Augustus
people.summary: Augustus, the first Roman emperor (27 BC - AD 14), issued the decree that 'all the world should be enrolled', which brought Joseph and Mary to Bethlehem, the city of David, where Jesus was born.
people.catholic: Luke sets the birth of the Prince of Peace in the reign of the emperor hailed as bringer of the Pax Romana and 'saviour', quietly contrasting the two. The Fathers saw God's providence using the census to fulfil the prophecy that the Messiah would be born in Bethlehem (Mic 5:2).
know: First Roman emperor.
His census decree brought the Holy Family to Bethlehem (Lk 2:1-4).
Reigned when Jesus was born.

people.name: Candace
people.summary: Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, is named as the sovereign whose treasurer, a eunuch, was baptized by Philip on the road to Gaza.
know: 'Candace' was a royal title of the queens of Meroë (Nubia).
Her official, baptized by Philip, is the first convert from Africa recorded in Acts.

people.name: Carpus
people.summary: Carpus kept the cloak Paul had left at Troas; Paul asks Timothy to bring it, together with the books and parchments.
know: Paul's cloak was left with him at Troas (2 Tim 4:13).

people.name: Chelub
people.summary: Chelub, 'the brother of Shuhah', is a Judahite clan head who became the father of Mehir (1 Chr 4:11).

people.name: Chenaanah
people.summary: Son of Bilhan in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 7:10).

people.name: Chesed
people.summary: A son of Nahor, Abraham's brother, by Milcah.
know: Often linked with the Chaldeans (Kasdim)

people.name: Chloe
people.summary: Members of Chloe's household reported to Paul the quarrels and factions among the Corinthians.
know: Her people informed Paul of divisions at Corinth (1 Cor 1:11).

people.name: Chuza
people.summary: Chuza (Chuzas) was the steward of Herod Antipas and husband of Joanna, one of the women who followed and supported Jesus.
know: Husband of Joanna (Lk 8:3).
A household official of Herod Antipas.

people.name: Claudia
people.summary: Claudia is one of the Roman Christians who send greetings to Timothy at the close of Paul's last letter.
know: Sends greetings in 2 Tim 4:21.

people.name: Clement
people.summary: Clement is named by Paul among his fellow workers at Philippi, 'whose names are in the book of life'.
people.catholic: Some early writers (e.g. Origen and Eusebius) identified him with St Clement of Rome, the third successor of Peter and author of the Letter to the Corinthians; this identification is uncertain.
know: Named as Paul's fellow worker (Phil 4:3).

people.name: Cleopas
people.role: Disciple on the road to Emmaus
people.summary: On the evening of the Resurrection, Cleopas and a companion walked to Emmaus. The risen Jesus joined them unrecognized, opened the Scriptures about himself, and was made known to them in the breaking of the bread.
people.catholic: The Emmaus account is a pattern of the Mass: the Liturgy of the Word, in which Christ explains the Scriptures, followed by the Liturgy of the Eucharist, in which he takes, blesses and breaks the bread (CCC 1347). 'Stay with us, for it is nearly evening' inspired St John Paul II's letter Mane Nobiscum Domine for the Year of the Eucharist.
know: One of two disciples on the road to Emmaus (Lk 24:13-18).
Recognized Jesus 'in the breaking of the bread' (Lk 24:35).
Sometimes identified with Clopas (Jn 19:25), but this is uncertain.

relations.type: met the risen Lord at Emmaus

people.name: Clopas
people.summary: Clopas is known only as the husband of Mary who stood by the cross of Jesus (Jn 19:25).
people.catholic: Tradition (Hegesippus, preserved by Eusebius) says Clopas was the brother of St Joseph and the father of Symeon, second bishop of Jerusalem. Some ancient writers identified him with Cleopas of Emmaus or with Alphaeus, but these identifications are uncertain.
know: Named once in Scripture (Jn 19:25).
By Tradition, brother of St Joseph.
By Tradition, father of Symeon, second bishop of Jerusalem.

people.name: Colhozeh
people.summary: Son of Hazaiah in the genealogy of Judah, among those who settled in Jerusalem under Nehemiah (Neh 11:5).

people.name: Cosam
people.summary: Cosam, son of Elmodam, appears only in Luke's genealogy of Jesus, which runs from Joseph back through David's son Nathan to Adam; he is listed as the father of Addi (Lk 3:28).
know: Named only in Luke's genealogy (Lk 3:28).
Son of Elmodam; father of Addi.

people.name: Crescens
people.summary: Crescens had left Paul in his final imprisonment to go to Galatia, presumably on mission.
know: Went to Galatia (2 Tim 4:10).

people.name: Cushi
people.summary: Cushi son of Gedaliah was the father of the prophet Zephaniah.
know: Not the 'Cushi' (Cushite messenger) of 2 Samuel 18.

people.name: Damaris
people.summary: Damaris was a woman of Athens who believed after hearing Paul's speech at the Areopagus.
know: Named with Dionysius among the Athenian converts (Acts 17:34).

people.name: Daughters of Philip (four)
people.summary: Philip the evangelist had four virgin daughters who prophesied; Paul and his companions stayed in their house at Caesarea.
people.catholic: They witness to the charism of prophecy given to women in the apostolic Church, fulfilling Joel's word quoted at Pentecost ('your daughters will prophesy', Acts 2:17).
know: A group of four unmarried sisters.
Exercised the gift of prophecy (Acts 21:9).

people.name: Deborah (Rebekah's nurse)
people.summary: Rebekah's nurse, who accompanied her from her family to Isaac and died much later near Bethel, where she was buried under the 'oak of weeping' (Allon Bacuth).
know: Went with Rebekah to Canaan (Gen 24:59)
Buried under the oak of Allon Bacuth (Gen 35:8)
Not Deborah the judge

people.name: Deborah (grandmother of Tobit)
people.summary: Tobit's paternal grandmother, who taught the orphaned Tobit to pay the third tithe for the needy.
know: Her instruction shaped Tobit's charity.

people.name: Delaiah
people.summary: Son of Elioenai in the genealogy of the royal line of David (1 Chr 3:24).

people.name: Demetrius (of 3 John)
people.summary: Demetrius 'has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself'; the Elder commends him, probably as the bearer of the letter to Gaius.
know: Commended in 3 John 12.

people.name: Diblaim
people.summary: Diblaim is named only as the father of Gomer, Hosea's wife.

people.name: Dibri
people.summary: Man of the tribe of Dan, father of Shelomith.
know: Father of Shelomith (Lev 24:11).
Of the tribe of Dan.

people.name: Dionysius the Areopagite
people.summary: Dionysius, a member of the Areopagus council of Athens, was one of the few who believed after Paul's speech on the 'unknown god'.
people.catholic: Early tradition (Dionysius of Corinth, via Eusebius) names him the first bishop of Athens. Influential mystical writings of about AD 500 were later circulated under his name ('Pseudo-Dionysius'), and in the West he was long confused with St Denis of Paris.
know: A member of the Areopagus (Acts 17:34).
Converted by Paul's Areopagus speech.
Writings attributed to him are by a later author ('Pseudo-Dionysius').

people.name: Diotrephes
people.summary: Diotrephes, 'who loves to be first', refused to acknowledge the Elder's authority, spread malicious words, would not welcome the travelling brothers, and expelled from the church those who did.
people.catholic: He is the New Testament's portrait of ambition and rejection of apostolic authority within the Church.
know: 'Loves to be first among them' (3 John 9).
Refused hospitality to the brothers and expelled those who gave it (3 John 10).

people.name: Dodo
people.summary: Man of Issachar, grandfather of the judge Tola.
know: Father of Puah, grandfather of Tola (Jdg 10:1).

people.name: Dositheus (bearer of the Purim letter)
people.summary: According to the closing note of Greek Esther, Dositheus 'who said he was a priest and Levite' and his son Ptolemeus brought the Letter of Purim (the Greek Esther) to Egypt in the fourth year of Ptolemy and Cleopatra; it had been translated in Jerusalem by Lysimachus son of Ptolemeus.
people.catholic: This colophon (Est 10:14 in this text) is a rare ancient note about how a biblical book was translated and transmitted.
know: Named in the colophon of Greek Esther.

people.name: Drusilla
people.summary: Drusilla, 'who was a Jewess', was the wife of the governor Felix; she was present when Felix sent for Paul and heard him speak about faith in Christ Jesus.
know: Wife of Felix (Acts 24:24).
Daughter of Herod Agrippa I and sister of Agrippa II and Bernice (per Josephus).

people.name: Eber
people.summary: Son of Abihail in the genealogy of Gad (1 Chr 5:13-14).

people.name: Eber
people.summary: Son of Elpaal in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:12).

people.name: Eber
people.summary: Son of Shashak in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:22; 8:25).

people.name: Eder
people.summary: Son of Beriah in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:15).

people.name: Ehi
people.summary: A son of Benjamin who went down to Egypt with Jacob's household.
know: Listed among the seventy of Jacob's house who came to Egypt (Gen 46)

people.name: Ehud
people.summary: Son of Bilhan in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 7:10).

people.name: Eker
people.summary: Son of Ram in the genealogy of Judah, among the Jerahmeelites (1 Chr 2:27).

people.name: Elah
people.summary: Son of Caleb in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 4:15).

people.name: Elah
people.summary: Son of Uzzi in the genealogy of Benjamin, among those who resettled Jerusalem (1 Chr 9:8).

people.name: Elam
people.summary: Son of Shashak in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:24; 8:25).

people.name: Elead
people.summary: Elead, a son of Ephraim, was killed with his brother Ezer by the men of Gath while raiding their livestock; Ephraim mourned for them many days (1 Chr 7:21-22).

people.name: Eleadah
people.summary: Son of Tahath in the genealogy of Ephraim (1 Chr 7:20).

people.name: Eleazar
people.summary: Eleazar, son of Eliud, appears only in Matthew's genealogy of Jesus as the father of Matthan (Mt 1:15), in the line of David's royal heirs after the Babylonian exile.
know: Named only in Matthew 1 - a link in Jesus' royal Davidic line after the exile.
Son of Eliud; father of Matthan.

people.name: Eleazar son of Abinadab
people.summary: Eleazar was consecrated by the men of Kiriath-jearim to keep the Ark of the LORD in his father's house.
know: Set apart to guard the Ark

people.name: Eliakim
people.summary: Eliakim, son of Abiud, appears only in Matthew's genealogy of Jesus as the father of Azor (Mt 1:13), in the line of David's royal heirs after the Babylonian exile.
know: Named only in Matthew 1 - a link in Jesus' royal Davidic line after the exile.
Son of Abiud; father of Azor.

people.name: Eliakim
people.summary: Eliakim, son of Melea, appears only in Luke's genealogy of Jesus, which runs from Joseph back through David's son Nathan to Adam; he is listed as the father of Jonan (Lk 3:30).
know: Named only in Luke's genealogy (Lk 3:30).
Son of Melea; father of Jonan.

people.name: Eliashib
people.summary: Son of Elioenai in the genealogy of the royal line of David (1 Chr 3:24).

people.name: Eliel
people.summary: Son of Shimei in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:20; 8:21).

people.name: Eliel
people.summary: Son of Shashak in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:22; 8:25).

people.name: Elienai
people.summary: Son of Shimei in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:20; 8:21).

people.name: Eliezer
people.summary: Son of Becher in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 7:8).

people.name: Eliezer
people.summary: Eliezer, son of Jorim, appears only in Luke's genealogy of Jesus, which runs from Joseph back through David's son Nathan to Adam; he is listed as the father of Jose (Lk 3:29).
know: Named only in Luke's genealogy (Lk 3:29).
Son of Jorim; father of Jose.

people.name: Eliezer of Damascus
people.summary: The servant of Abraham's household who would have been his heir while Abram was childless.
know: Abram's presumed heir before Isaac (Gen 15:2-3)
Tradition often identifies him with the unnamed senior servant who found Rebekah (Gen 24), but the text does not name that servant

people.name: Elijah
people.summary: Son of Jeroham in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:27).

people.name: Elioenai
people.summary: Son of Becher in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 7:8).

people.name: Eliphelet
people.summary: Son of Eshek in the genealogy of Benjamin, house of Saul (1 Chr 8:39).

people.name: Elishama
people.summary: Son of Jekamiah in the genealogy of Judah, among the Jerahmeelites (1 Chr 2:41).

people.name: Elisheba
people.summary: Daughter of Amminadab of Judah and sister of Nahshon, prince of Judah. She married Aaron and bore Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, so that the priestly line of Israel descends from her.
people.catholic: Elisheba unites the priestly tribe of Levi with the royal tribe of Judah. Some Christian writers note that her name is the Hebrew form of 'Elizabeth', borne by the priestly mother of John the Baptist, who was 'of the daughters of Aaron' (Lk 1:5).
know: Daughter of Amminadab, sister of Nahshon (Exo 6:23).
Wife of Aaron.
Mother of Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

people.name: Elkanah
people.summary: Elkanah is named in the genealogy of the Levites who resettled Jerusalem (1 Chr 9:16).

people.name: Elkanah
people.summary: Elkanah was a son of Korah listed in the Levitical genealogy of Exodus 6; the line of Korah survived the rebellion and later supplied temple singers.
know: Son of Korah (Exo 6:24).
Ancestor of a Korahite family.
Korah's sons did not die in the rebellion (Num 26:11).

people.name: Elmodam
people.summary: Elmodam, son of Er, appears only in Luke's genealogy of Jesus, which runs from Joseph back through David's son Nathan to Adam; he is listed as the father of Cosam (Lk 3:28).
know: Named only in Luke's genealogy (Lk 3:28).
Son of Er; father of Cosam.

people.name: Elpelet
people.summary: Elpelet (an earlier Eliphelet in 1 Chr 3:6) was a son of David born in Jerusalem.
know: Listed only in Chronicles

people.name: Epaenetus
people.summary: Epaenetus is named in the greetings of Paul's Letter to the Romans. Paul's 'beloved', 'the first fruits of Achaia to Christ'.
know: Paul's 'beloved', 'the first fruits of Achaia to Christ'.

people.name: Ephah
people.role: Concubine of Caleb son of Hezron
people.summary: Ephah, a concubine of Caleb son of Hezron, bore Haran, Moza and Gazez (1 Chr 2:46).

people.name: Ephah
people.summary: Son of Jahdai in the genealogy of Judah, among the Calebites (1 Chr 2:47).

people.name: Epher
people.summary: Son of Ezrah in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 4:17).

people.name: Ephlal
people.summary: Son of Zabad in the genealogy of Judah, among the Jerahmeelites (1 Chr 2:37).

people.name: Er
people.summary: Son of Shelah in the genealogy of Judah, house of Shelah (1 Chr 4:21). Called 'the father of Lecah'.

people.name: Er
people.summary: Er, son of Jose, appears only in Luke's genealogy of Jesus, which runs from Joseph back through David's son Nathan to Adam; he is listed as the father of Elmodam (Lk 3:28).
know: Named only in Luke's genealogy (Lk 3:28).
Son of Jose; father of Elmodam.

people.name: Eshek
people.summary: Eshek, brother of Azel in the line of Saul, was the father of Ulam, whose sons were mighty archers (1 Chr 8:39-40).

people.name: Esli
people.summary: Esli, son of Naggai, appears only in Luke's genealogy of Jesus, which runs from Joseph back through David's son Nathan to Adam; he is listed as the father of Nahum (Lk 3:25).
know: Named only in Luke's genealogy (Lk 3:25).
Son of Naggai; father of Nahum.

people.name: Ethan
people.summary: Son of Zimmah in the genealogy of Levi, among the Gershonites (1 Chr 6:42). In the ancestry of Asaph the singer.

people.name: Ethbaal
people.summary: Ethbaal king of the Sidonians was the father of Jezebel, Ahab's queen.
know: Phoenician king

people.name: Ethnan
people.summary: Son of Ashhur and Helah in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 4:7).

people.name: Ethni
people.summary: Son of Zerah in the genealogy of Levi, among the Gershonites (1 Chr 6:41). In the ancestry of Asaph the singer.

people.name: Eubulus
people.summary: Eubulus is one of the Roman Christians who send greetings to Timothy at the close of Paul's last letter.
know: Sends greetings in 2 Tim 4:21.

people.name: Eunice
people.summary: Eunice was a Jewish woman who became a believer, the wife of a Greek, and the mother of Timothy. Paul praises the 'sincere faith' that lived in her and in her mother Lois before it lived in Timothy.
people.catholic: With Lois she is a model of mothers and grandmothers who hand on the faith, the family as 'domestic church' where children first learn the Scriptures (2 Tim 3:15).
know: A believing Jewish woman married to a Greek (Acts 16:1).
Mother of Timothy (2 Tim 1:5).

people.name: Euodia
people.summary: Euodia was one of two women at Philippi who had laboured with Paul in the gospel; Paul urges her and Syntyche to 'think the same way in the Lord' and asks a 'true partner' to help them reconcile.
people.catholic: Paul's appeal is a model of fraternal reconciliation within the Church; he honors both women as co-workers whose names are in the book of life.
know: Laboured with Paul in the gospel (Phil 4:3).
Urged to agree with her fellow worker (Phil 4:2).

people.name: Eutychus
people.summary: Eutychus was a young man at Troas who fell asleep in a window during Paul's long sermon on the first day of the week and fell three stories to his death. Paul went down, embraced him, and he was restored to life; the gathering then broke bread and continued till dawn.
people.catholic: The setting, the community gathered 'on the first day of the week... to break bread' (Acts 20:7), is an early witness to the Sunday Eucharist (cf. CCC 1343).
know: Fell from a third-story window at Troas.
Raised by Paul (Acts 20:10-12).
The scene takes place at a Sunday breaking of bread (Acts 20:7).

people.name: Ezbon
people.summary: Son of Bela in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 7:7).

people.name: Ezbon
people.summary: A son of Gad who went down to Egypt with Jacob's household.
know: Listed among the seventy of Jacob's house who came to Egypt (Gen 46)

people.name: Ezer
people.summary: Son of Hur in the genealogy of Judah, house of Hur (1 Chr 4:4). Called 'the father of Hushah'.

people.name: Ezer
people.summary: Ezer, a son of Ephraim, was killed with his brother Elead by the men of Gath while raiding their livestock; Ephraim mourned for them many days (1 Chr 7:21-22).

people.name: Ezrah
people.summary: Ezrah heads a Judahite family; his son Mered married Bithiah, a daughter of Pharaoh (1 Chr 4:17-18).

people.name: Fortunatus
people.summary: Fortunatus came to Paul from Corinth with Stephanas and Achaicus, refreshing Paul's spirit and supplying what the Corinthians lacked.
know: Visited Paul with Stephanas (1 Cor 16:17).

people.name: Gaddi
people.summary: Son of Susi, the man of Manasseh among the twelve sent by Moses to scout Canaan. With nine others he brought back an 'evil report' that discouraged the people; those ten died by plague before the LORD.
know: Represented Manasseh among the twelve spies (Num 13).
Brought back a discouraging report.
Died by plague (Num 14:36-37).

people.name: Gaddiel
people.summary: Son of Sodi, the man of Zebulun among the twelve sent by Moses to scout Canaan. With nine others he brought back an 'evil report' that discouraged the people; those ten died by plague before the LORD.
know: Represented Zebulun among the twelve spies (Num 13).
Brought back a discouraging report.
Died by plague (Num 14:36-37).

people.name: Gaham
people.summary: A child of Nahor, Abraham's brother, by his concubine Reumah.
know: Child of Nahor and Reumah (Gen 22:24)

people.name: Gaius (of 3 John)
people.summary: Gaius 'the beloved' is the addressee of the Third Letter of John. The Elder praises him for walking in the truth and for his faithful hospitality to travelling missionaries, in contrast to Diotrephes.
people.catholic: Gaius is a model of Christian hospitality to those who go out 'for the sake of the Name' (3 John 7), making him a 'fellow worker for the truth'.
know: Addressee of 3 John.
Praised for welcoming travelling brothers (3 John 5-8).

people.name: Gaius of Derbe
people.summary: Gaius of Derbe was among the companions who accompanied Paul from Greece toward Jerusalem at the end of the third missionary journey.
know: From Derbe in Lycaonia (Acts 20:4).

people.name: Gaius of Macedonia
people.summary: Gaius, a Macedonian travelling companion of Paul, was seized with Aristarchus and dragged into the theater during the riot at Ephesus.
know: Seized in the Ephesian riot (Acts 19:29).
Possibly identical with another Gaius of the New Testament; this cannot be determined.

people.name: Gazez
people.summary: Son of Caleb and Ephah in the genealogy of Judah, among the Calebites (1 Chr 2:46).

people.name: Gazez
people.summary: Son of Haran in the genealogy of Judah, among the Calebites (1 Chr 2:46).

people.name: Gedaliah son of Amariah
people.summary: Gedaliah son of Amariah was the grandfather of the prophet Zephaniah.
know: Not Gedaliah the governor, son of Ahikam.

people.name: Gedaliah son of Pashhur
people.summary: Gedaliah son of Pashhur was among the officials who had Jeremiah lowered into the cistern.
know: Not Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the governor.

people.name: Gera
people.summary: Benjamite, father of the judge Ehud.
know: Father of Ehud (Jdg 3:15).

people.name: Geshan
people.summary: Son of Jahdai in the genealogy of Judah, among the Calebites (1 Chr 2:47).

people.name: Geuel
people.summary: Son of Machi, the man of Gad among the twelve sent by Moses to scout Canaan. With nine others he brought back an 'evil report' that discouraged the people; those ten died by plague before the LORD.
know: Represented Gad among the twelve spies (Num 13).
Brought back a discouraging report.
Died by plague (Num 14:36-37).

people.name: Gilead
people.summary: Son of Michael in the genealogy of Gad (1 Chr 5:14).

people.name: Gog
people.summary: Son of Shemaiah in the genealogy of Reuben (1 Chr 5:4).

people.name: Gomer
people.summary: Gomer, daughter of Diblaim, was the wife God told Hosea to marry, 'a wife of prostitution'. She bore three children whose names announced judgment on Israel; her unfaithfulness and Hosea's command to love her again mirror Israel's idolatry and God's faithful love.
people.catholic: In the Church's reading Gomer stands for Israel — and every soul — unfaithful to God, whom the divine Bridegroom pursues and restores; the pattern is fulfilled in Christ who loves the Church and gives himself up for her (Eph 5:25).
know: Daughter of Diblaim (Hos 1:3).
Mother of Jezreel, Lo-ruhamah and Lo-ammi.
Hos 3:1-3 (Hosea buys back an adulterous woman) is usually understood to refer to Gomer.

people.name: Guni
people.summary: Guni is named in the genealogy of Gad (1 Chr 5:15).

people.name: Haahashtari
people.summary: Son of Ashhur and Naarah in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 4:6).

people.name: Hadad
people.summary: A son of Ishmael and ancestor of an Arabian tribe.
know: One of the twelve princes descended from Ishmael (Gen 25:16)

people.name: Haggiah
people.summary: Son of Shimea in the genealogy of Levi, among the Merarites (1 Chr 6:30).

people.name: Hakkoz
people.summary: Hakkoz, of the clans of Judah, became the father of Anub and Zobebah (1 Chr 4:8).

people.name: Hammolecheth
people.summary: Hammolecheth, sister of Gilead and daughter of Machir, bore Ishhod, Abiezer and Mahlah (1 Chr 7:17-18).

people.name: Hammuel
people.summary: Son of Mishma in the genealogy of Simeon (1 Chr 4:26).

people.name: Hanan
people.summary: Son of Shashak in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:23; 8:25).

people.name: Hananiah
people.summary: Son of Shashak in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:24; 8:25).

people.name: Hananiah, governor of the fortress
people.summary: Commander of the fortress whom Nehemiah set over Jerusalem with Hanani, 'a faithful man who feared God above many'.
know: Praised as faithful and God-fearing (Neh 7:2).

people.name: Hanniel
people.summary: Son of Ulla in the genealogy of Asher (1 Chr 7:39).

people.name: Haran
people.summary: Son of Caleb and Ephah in the genealogy of Judah, among the Calebites (1 Chr 2:46).

people.name: Hareph
people.summary: Son of Hur in the genealogy of Judah, house of Hur (1 Chr 2:51). Called 'the father of Beth-gader'.

people.name: Harnepher
people.summary: Son of Zophah in the genealogy of Asher (1 Chr 7:36).

people.name: Harum
people.summary: Harum is the father of Aharhel, whose families are listed in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 4:8).

people.name: Hasadiah
people.summary: Son of Zerubbabel in the genealogy of the royal line of David (1 Chr 3:20).

people.name: Hashabiah
people.summary: Son of Amaziah in the genealogy of Levi, among the Merarites (1 Chr 6:45). In the ancestry of Ethan the singer.

people.name: Hashabiah
people.summary: Son of Mattaniah in the genealogy of the Levites who resettled Jerusalem (Neh 11:22).

people.name: Hashubah
people.summary: Son of Zerubbabel in the genealogy of the royal line of David (1 Chr 3:20).

people.name: Hassenuah
people.summary: Hassenuah is named in the genealogy of Benjamin, among those who resettled Jerusalem (1 Chr 9:7).

people.name: Hathath
people.summary: Son of Othniel in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 4:13).

people.name: Hattush
people.summary: Son of Shemaiah in the genealogy of the royal line of David (1 Chr 3:22).

people.name: Hazaiah
people.summary: Son of Adaiah in the genealogy of Judah, among those who settled in Jerusalem under Nehemiah (Neh 11:5).

people.name: Hazo
people.summary: A son of Nahor, Abraham's brother, by Milcah.
know: Son of Nahor and Milcah

people.name: Heber
people.summary: Son of Mered and Mered's Judahite wife in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 4:18). Called 'the father of Soco'.

people.name: Heber
people.summary: Son of Elpaal in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:17).

people.name: Helez
people.summary: Son of Azariah in the genealogy of Judah, among the Jerahmeelites (1 Chr 2:39).

people.name: Heli
people.summary: Heli is named in Luke's genealogy as the father of Joseph, 'the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli' (Lk 3:23).
people.catholic: Matthew names Joseph's father as Jacob (Mt 1:16). Ancient and modern interpreters reconcile the two: Julius Africanus (3rd century) proposed a levirate marriage, making one the natural and the other the legal father, while others hold that Luke traces Mary's line, Heli being Joseph's father-in-law. The Church has not defined the question.
know: Named only in Luke 3:23.
Matthew 1:16 names Jacob as Joseph's father - the two genealogies differ here.
Some interpreters read Luke's line as Mary's, making Heli her father; Tradition otherwise names her father Joachim.

people.name: Heman
people.summary: Son of Zerah in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 2:6). Sometimes identified with the sage Heman of 1 Kgs 4:31.

people.name: Hepher
people.summary: Son of Ashhur and Naarah in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 4:6).

people.name: Hephzibah
people.summary: Hephzibah was the wife of Hezekiah and mother of King Manasseh.
know: Her name ('my delight is in her') is later used of Zion in Isa 62:4

people.name: Hermas
people.summary: Hermas is named in the greetings of Paul's Letter to the Romans. Greeted with Asyncritus and others.
know: Greeted with Asyncritus and others.

people.name: Hermes
people.summary: Hermes is named in the greetings of Paul's Letter to the Romans. A Roman Christian greeted with Asyncritus and others.
know: A Roman Christian greeted with Asyncritus and others.

people.name: Hermogenes
people.summary: Hermogenes is named among all those in Asia who turned away from Paul during his final imprisonment.
know: Named in 2 Tim 1:15 as one who turned away from Paul.

people.name: Herodion
people.summary: Herodion is named in the greetings of Paul's Letter to the Romans. 'My kinsman'.
know: 'My kinsman'.

people.name: Hilkiah
people.summary: Son of Amzi in the genealogy of Levi, among the Merarites (1 Chr 6:45). In the ancestry of Ethan the singer.

people.name: Hilkiah of Anathoth
people.summary: Hilkiah was a priest of Anathoth in Benjamin and the father of Jeremiah.
know: Not to be identified with certainty with Hilkiah the high priest who found the Book of the Law under Josiah.

people.name: Hizki
people.summary: Son of Elpaal in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:17).

people.name: Hizkiah
people.summary: Son of Neariah in the genealogy of the royal line of David (1 Chr 3:23).

people.name: Hod
people.summary: Son of Zophah in the genealogy of Asher (1 Chr 7:37).

people.name: Hodaviah
people.summary: Son of Elioenai in the genealogy of the royal line of David (1 Chr 3:24).

people.name: Hodaviah
people.summary: Son of Hassenuah in the genealogy of Benjamin, among those who resettled Jerusalem (1 Chr 9:7).

people.name: Hodesh
people.summary: Hodesh, a wife of Shaharaim the Benjamite, bore him seven sons in Moab (1 Chr 8:9-10).

people.name: Hoham
people.summary: King of Hebron, one of the five Amorite kings who joined Adoni-Zedek against Gibeon and were defeated by Joshua and executed at Makkedah.
know: King of Hebron (Jos 10:3).
Member of the five-king coalition.
Executed at Makkedah (Jos 10:26).

people.name: Hoshama
people.summary: Hoshama is listed among the sons of Jehoiachin (Jeconiah) the captive.
know: Born in the Babylonian exile

people.name: Huram
people.summary: Son of Bela in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:5).

people.name: Huri
people.summary: Son of Jaroah in the genealogy of Gad (1 Chr 5:14).

people.name: Hushim (son of Dan)
people.summary: A son of Dan who went down to Egypt with Jacob's household.
know: Listed among the seventy of Jacob's house who came to Egypt (Gen 46)
Dan's only son; called Shuham in Num 26:42

people.name: Hyrcanus son of Tobias
people.summary: A wealthy man of high standing whose money was deposited in the Temple treasury that Heliodorus came to seize.
know: Of the Tobiad family; possibly descended from Nehemiah's Tobiah.
Not John Hyrcanus.

people.name: Ibneiah
people.summary: Son of Jeroham in the genealogy of Benjamin, among those who resettled Jerusalem (1 Chr 9:8).

people.name: Ibnijah
people.summary: Ibnijah is named in the genealogy of Benjamin, among those who resettled Jerusalem (1 Chr 9:8).

people.name: Ibsam
people.summary: Son of Tola in the genealogy of Issachar (1 Chr 7:2).

people.name: Iddo
people.summary: Son of Joah in the genealogy of Levi, among the Gershonites (1 Chr 6:21).

people.name: Igal
people.summary: Son of Shemaiah in the genealogy of the royal line of David (1 Chr 3:22).

people.name: Igal
people.summary: Son of Joseph, the man of Issachar among the twelve sent by Moses to scout Canaan. With nine others he brought back an 'evil report' that discouraged the people; those ten died by plague before the LORD.
know: Represented Issachar among the twelve spies (Num 13).
Brought back a discouraging report.
Died by plague (Num 14:36-37).

people.name: Immer
people.summary: Immer is the ancestor of a priestly house (cf. 1 Chr 24:14) from which the post-exilic priest Maasai descended (1 Chr 9:12).

people.name: Imna
people.summary: Son of Hotham in the genealogy of Asher (1 Chr 7:35).

people.name: Imrah
people.summary: Son of Zophah in the genealogy of Asher (1 Chr 7:36).

people.name: Imri
people.summary: Son of Bani in the genealogy of Judah, among those who resettled Jerusalem (1 Chr 9:4).

people.name: Iob
people.summary: A son of Issachar who went down to Egypt with Jacob's household.
know: Listed among the seventy of Jacob's house who came to Egypt (Gen 46)
Called Jashub in Num 26:24

people.name: Iphdeiah
people.summary: Son of Shashak in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:25).

people.name: Irad
people.summary: Son of Enoch and grandson of Cain; father of Mehujael.
know: Part of Cain's line in Gen 4

people.name: Iri
people.summary: Son of Bela in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 7:7).

people.name: Iru
people.summary: Son of Caleb in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 4:15).

people.name: Iscah
people.summary: Daughter of Haran and sister of Milcah and Lot.
know: Mentioned only once (Gen 11:29)
Jewish tradition identified her with Sarai, but Genesis does not say so

people.name: Ishbah
people.summary: Son of Mered and Bithiah in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 4:17). Called 'the father of Eshtemoa'.

people.name: Ishhod
people.summary: Son of Hammolecheth in the genealogy of Manasseh (1 Chr 7:18).

people.name: Ishi
people.summary: Son of Appaim in the genealogy of Judah, among the Jerahmeelites (1 Chr 2:31).

people.name: Ishi
people.summary: Ishi heads a Judahite family; his sons were Zoheth and Ben-zoheth (1 Chr 4:20).

people.name: Ishi
people.summary: Ishi, a Simeonite, was the father of the four captains who led five hundred men to Mount Seir and destroyed the remnant of the Amalekites (1 Chr 4:42-43).

people.name: Ishmerai
people.summary: Son of Elpaal in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:18).

people.name: Ishpah
people.summary: Son of Beriah in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:16).

people.name: Ishpan
people.summary: Son of Shashak in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:22; 8:25).

people.name: Isshiah
people.summary: Son of Izrahiah in the genealogy of Issachar (1 Chr 7:3).

people.name: Ithran
people.summary: Son of Zophah in the genealogy of Asher (1 Chr 7:37).

people.name: Izhar
people.summary: Son of Ashhur and Helah in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 4:7).

people.name: Izliah
people.summary: Son of Elpaal in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:18).

people.name: Izrahiah
people.summary: Son of Uzzi in the genealogy of Issachar (1 Chr 7:3).

people.name: Jaareshiah
people.summary: Son of Jeroham in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:27).

people.name: Jaazaniah son of Azzur
people.summary: Jaazaniah son of Azzur was among the twenty-five men at the east gate whom Ezekiel saw devising wicked counsel in Jerusalem.
know: Different from Jaazaniah son of Shaphan (Ezek 8:11).

people.name: Jaazaniah son of Shaphan
people.summary: Jaazaniah son of Shaphan stood among seventy elders whom Ezekiel saw in vision offering incense to idols in a hidden Temple chamber.
know: Ironic, since his family (Shaphan's) was otherwise faithful to Jeremiah.

people.name: Jaazaniah the Rechabite
people.summary: Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah, son of Habazziniah, headed the Rechabite household whom the prophet Jeremiah brought into a Temple chamber and offered wine, which they refused.
know: His father Jeremiah is not the prophet.

people.name: Jabal
people.summary: Son of Lamech and Adah, 'the father of those who dwell in tents and have livestock'.
know: Ancestor of nomadic herdsmen (Gen 4:20)

people.name: Jabin (in Joshua)
people.summary: King of Hazor who gathered the kings of northern Canaan against Israel at the waters of Merom. Joshua defeated the coalition, killed Jabin and burned Hazor.
know: King of Hazor, head of the northern kingdoms (Jos 11:10).
Defeated at the waters of Merom (Jos 11:7-8).
A later Jabin of Hazor oppressed Israel in Deborah's day (Jdg 4:2).

people.name: Jacan
people.summary: Son of Abihail in the genealogy of Gad (1 Chr 5:13-14).

people.name: Jahath
people.summary: Son of Reaiah in the genealogy of Judah, house of Hur (1 Chr 4:2).

people.name: Jahdai
people.summary: Jahdai heads a Calebite family whose six sons are listed in 1 Chr 2:47; his own descent is not stated.

people.name: Jahdo
people.summary: Son of Buz in the genealogy of Gad (1 Chr 5:14).

people.name: Jahmai
people.summary: Son of Tola in the genealogy of Issachar (1 Chr 7:2).

people.name: Jahzerah
people.summary: Son of Meshullam in the genealogy of the priests who resettled Jerusalem (1 Chr 9:12).

people.name: Jakeh
people.summary: Father of the sage Agur.
know: Known only from Prov 30:1.

people.name: Jakim
people.summary: Son of Shimei in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:19; 8:21).

people.name: Jalon
people.summary: Son of Ezrah in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 4:17).

people.name: Jambres
people.summary: Jambres is named by Paul, with Jannes, as one who opposed Moses; Jewish tradition gave these names to Pharaoh's magicians who imitated Moses' signs (Exodus 7:11-12).
know: Named only in 2 Tim 3:8; the names come from Jewish tradition.
Identified with Pharaoh's magicians of Exodus 7.

people.name: Jamin
people.summary: Son of Ram in the genealogy of Judah, among the Jerahmeelites (1 Chr 2:27).

people.name: Jannai
people.summary: Jannai, son of Joseph, appears only in Luke's genealogy of Jesus, which runs from Joseph back through David's son Nathan to Adam; he is listed as the father of Melchi (Lk 3:24).
know: Named only in Luke's genealogy (Lk 3:24).
Son of Joseph; father of Melchi.

people.name: Jannes
people.summary: Jannes is named by Paul, with Jambres, as one who opposed Moses; Jewish tradition gave these names to Pharaoh's magicians who imitated Moses' signs (Exodus 7:11-12).
know: Named only in 2 Tim 3:8; the names come from Jewish tradition.
Identified with Pharaoh's magicians of Exodus 7.

people.name: Japhia
people.summary: King of Lachish, one of the five Amorite kings who joined Adoni-Zedek against Gibeon and were defeated by Joshua and executed at Makkedah.
know: King of Lachish (Jos 10:3).
Member of the five-king coalition.
Executed at Makkedah (Jos 10:26).

people.name: Jaroah
people.summary: Son of Gilead in the genealogy of Gad (1 Chr 5:14).

people.name: Jason of Cyrene
people.summary: The Jewish historian whose five-volume history of the Maccabean revolt the author of 2 Maccabees abridged into one book.
people.catholic: The epitomist's preface and epilogue (2 Macc 2:19-32; 15:37-39), describing the toil of condensing a source, are a candid witness that inspired authors used human sources and labor — a point the Church notes in teaching that God used human authors 'with their own faculties and powers' (cf. CCC 106).
know: Wrote five books on the revolt (2 Macc 2:23).

people.name: Jeatherai
people.summary: Son of Zerah in the genealogy of Levi, among the Gershonites (1 Chr 6:21).

people.name: Jedaiah
people.summary: Son of Shimri in the genealogy of Simeon (1 Chr 4:37).

people.name: Jedidah
people.summary: Jedidah daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath was the wife of Amon and mother of King Josiah.
know: Mother of Josiah

people.name: Jehallelel
people.summary: Jehallelel heads a Judahite family whose sons are listed in 1 Chr 4:16.

people.name: Jehu
people.summary: Son of Obed in the genealogy of Judah, among the Jerahmeelites (1 Chr 2:38).

people.name: Jehu
people.summary: Jehu son of Joshibiah was one of the Simeonite princes who in Hezekiah's days seized pasture land at Gedor (1 Chr 4:35-41).

people.name: Jehubbah
people.summary: Son of Shomer in the genealogy of Asher (1 Chr 7:34).

people.name: Jeiel
people.summary: Jeiel, 'the father of Gibeon', lived there with his wife Maacah; Chronicles places Saul's family among his descendants (1 Chr 8:29-32; 9:35-38).

people.name: Jekamiah
people.summary: Son of Shallum in the genealogy of Judah, among the Jerahmeelites (1 Chr 2:41).

people.name: Jekamiah
people.summary: Jekamiah is listed among the sons of Jehoiachin (Jeconiah) the captive.
know: Born in the Babylonian exile

people.name: Jekuthiel
people.summary: Son of Mered and Mered's Judahite wife in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 4:18). Called 'the father of Zanoah'.

people.name: Jemimah
people.summary: The first of the three daughters born to Job after his restoration; Job's daughters were the most beautiful in the land and received an inheritance with their brothers.
know: Name often taken to mean 'dove'.
Received an inheritance (Job 42:15).

people.name: Jephunneh
people.summary: Son of Jether in the genealogy of Asher (1 Chr 7:38).

people.name: Jered
people.summary: Son of Mered and Mered's Judahite wife in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 4:18). Called 'the father of Gedor'.

people.name: Jeremoth
people.summary: Son of Becher in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 7:8).

people.name: Jeremoth
people.summary: Son of Beriah in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:14).

people.name: Jeriel
people.summary: Son of Tola in the genealogy of Issachar (1 Chr 7:2).

people.name: Jerimoth
people.summary: Son of Bela in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 7:7).

people.name: Jerimoth
people.summary: Jerimoth, a son of David not in the main lists (perhaps by a concubine), was the father of Rehoboam's wife Mahalath.
know: Grandfather-in-law line of Rehoboam

people.name: Jerioth
people.role: Wife of Caleb son of Hezron
people.summary: Jerioth is named with Azubah as a woman by whom Caleb son of Hezron had children (1 Chr 2:18).

people.name: Jeroham
people.summary: Jeroham is the head of a Benjamite family in Jerusalem whose six sons are listed in 1 Chr 8:26-27.

people.name: Jeroham
people.summary: Jeroham is named in the genealogy of Benjamin, among those who resettled Jerusalem (1 Chr 9:8).

people.name: Jeroham
people.summary: Son of Pashhur son of Malchijah in the genealogy of the priests who resettled Jerusalem (1 Chr 9:12).

people.name: Jeshaiah
people.summary: Son of Hananiah in the genealogy of the royal line of David (1 Chr 3:21).

people.name: Jesher
people.summary: Son of Caleb in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 2:18).

people.name: Jeshishai
people.summary: Son of Jahdo in the genealogy of Gad (1 Chr 5:14).

people.name: Jesus called Justus
people.summary: Jesus, called Justus, was one of the few Jewish-born fellow workers of Paul who were a comfort to him during his imprisonment.
know: One of Paul's fellow workers 'of the circumcision' (Col 4:11).

people.name: Jesus son of Sirach
people.summary: Jesus (Yeshua) son of Eleazar son of Sirach, a scribe and teacher of wisdom in Jerusalem around 190-180 BC, wrote the book of Sirach, whose Greek translation was made by his grandson in Egypt. His book unites wisdom with the Law and Temple worship and closes with the great 'praise of the fathers' (Sir 44-50), from Enoch to the high priest Simon son of Onias.
people.catholic: Sirach is a deuterocanonical book, received in the Church's canon (Rome 382, Carthage 397, Trent 1546). Its Latin name Ecclesiasticus ('the Church's book') reflects its constant use in teaching catechumens and the faithful, and it is read often in the Lectionary. Its portrait of Wisdom dwelling in Israel (Sir 24) prepares for John's prologue ('the Word became flesh and dwelt among us'), and its 'praise of the fathers' is a model for Hebrews 11.
know: Signs his book in Sir 50:27.
Book also called Ecclesiasticus.
His grandson's translator's prologue is not versified in this text.
The 'praise of the fathers' omits Ezra but includes Nehemiah (Sir 49:13).

people.name: Jether
people.summary: Son of Jada in the genealogy of Judah, among the Jerahmeelites (1 Chr 2:32). He died without children.

people.name: Jether
people.summary: Son of Ezrah in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 4:17).

people.name: Jether
people.summary: Jether, an Asherite clan head (perhaps the Ithran of 1 Chr 7:37), was the father of Jephunneh, Pispa and Ara (1 Chr 7:38).

people.name: Jether
people.summary: Gideon's firstborn, who as a youth was told to kill the captured kings Zebah and Zalmunna but was afraid to draw his sword.
know: Gideon's firstborn (Jdg 8:20).
Too afraid to kill the Midianite kings.

people.name: Jeush
people.summary: Son of Bilhan in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 7:10).

people.name: Jeush
people.summary: Son of Eshek in the genealogy of Benjamin, house of Saul (1 Chr 8:39).

people.name: Jeuz
people.summary: Son of Shaharaim and Hodesh in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:10).

people.name: Jezebel of Thyatira
people.summary: In the letter to Thyatira the risen Christ rebukes the church for tolerating 'that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess' and leads his servants into immorality and eating food sacrificed to idols; she was given time to repent but refused.
people.catholic: Whether a real woman or a symbolic name, she is called after Ahab's queen Jezebel, who led Israel into idolatry; she stands for false teaching that compromises with pagan practice.
know: Named in Rev 2:20.
Called by the name of the idolatrous queen Jezebel (1 Kings 16-21).
Given time to repent but refused (Rev 2:21).

people.name: Jidlaph
people.summary: A son of Nahor, Abraham's brother, by Milcah.
know: Son of Nahor and Milcah

people.name: Joab
people.summary: Son of Seraiah in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 4:14). Called 'the father of Ge-harashim' (valley of craftsmen).

people.name: Joah
people.summary: Son of Zimmah in the genealogy of Levi, among the Gershonites (1 Chr 6:21).

people.name: Joanan
people.summary: Joanan, son of Rhesa, appears only in Luke's genealogy of Jesus, which runs from Joseph back through David's son Nathan to Adam; he is listed as the father of Judah (Lk 3:27).
know: Named only in Luke's genealogy (Lk 3:27).
Son of Rhesa; father of Judah.

people.name: Joash
people.summary: Son of Shelah in the genealogy of Judah, house of Shelah (1 Chr 4:22). He and Saraph 'had dominion in Moab'.

people.name: Joash
people.summary: Son of Becher in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 7:8).

people.name: Jobab
people.summary: Son of Shaharaim and Hodesh in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:9).

people.name: Jobab
people.summary: Son of Elpaal in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:18).

people.name: Jobab
people.summary: King of Madon summoned by Jabin of Hazor to join the northern coalition against Joshua.
know: King of Madon (Jos 11:1).
Ally of Jabin of Hazor.

people.name: Joel
people.summary: Son of Azariah in the genealogy of Levi, among the Kohathites (1 Chr 6:36). In the ancestry of Samuel and Heman the singer.

people.name: Joel
people.summary: Son of Izrahiah in the genealogy of Issachar (1 Chr 7:3).

people.name: Joha
people.summary: Son of Beriah in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:16).

people.name: Johanan
people.summary: Son of Elioenai in the genealogy of the royal line of David (1 Chr 3:24).

people.name: Joiarib
people.summary: Son of Zechariah in the genealogy of Judah, among those who settled in Jerusalem under Nehemiah (Neh 11:5).

people.name: Jokim
people.summary: Son of Shelah in the genealogy of Judah, house of Shelah (1 Chr 4:22).

people.name: Jonan
people.summary: Jonan, son of Eliakim, appears only in Luke's genealogy of Jesus, which runs from Joseph back through David's son Nathan to Adam; he is listed as the father of Joseph (Lk 3:30).
know: Named only in Luke's genealogy (Lk 3:30).
Son of Eliakim; father of Joseph.

people.name: Jonathan (son of Gershom)
people.summary: Young Levite from Bethlehem in Judah who became Micah's household priest, then went with the Danites, who set up Micah's image at Laish (Dan). Judges 18:30 identifies him as 'Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Moses', whose sons were priests to Dan until the captivity.
know: Levite from Bethlehem who served Micah (Jdg 17:7-13).
Went with the Danites as their priest (Jdg 18:19-20).
Grandson (descendant) of Moses (Jdg 18:30; the Hebrew text has a suspended letter making 'Manasseh').

people.name: Jonathan son of Kareah
people.summary: Jonathan, brother of Johanan, was one of the captains who came to Gedaliah at Mizpah.

people.name: Jorai
people.summary: Son of Abihail in the genealogy of Gad (1 Chr 5:13-14).

people.name: Jorim
people.summary: Jorim, son of Matthat, appears only in Luke's genealogy of Jesus, which runs from Joseph back through David's son Nathan to Adam; he is listed as the father of Eliezer (Lk 3:29).
know: Named only in Luke's genealogy (Lk 3:29).
Son of Matthat; father of Eliezer.

people.name: Jose
people.summary: Jose, son of Eliezer, appears only in Luke's genealogy of Jesus, which runs from Joseph back through David's son Nathan to Adam; he is listed as the father of Er (Lk 3:29).
know: Named only in Luke's genealogy (Lk 3:29).
Son of Eliezer; father of Er.

people.name: Joseph Barsabbas
people.summary: Joseph called Barsabbas, surnamed Justus, was one of the two disciples proposed to replace Judas Iscariot among the Twelve; the lot fell on Matthias instead.
people.catholic: He is honored as one of the early disciples who had followed Jesus throughout his public ministry. His candidacy shows the criterion of apostolic witness to the whole ministry of Jesus.
know: Also called Justus (Acts 1:23).
A witness of Jesus' whole ministry, from John's baptism to the Ascension.
Not chosen: the lot fell on Matthias.

people.name: Joshah
people.summary: Joshah son of Amaziah was one of the Simeonite princes who in Hezekiah's days seized pasture land at Gedor (1 Chr 4:34-41).

people.name: Joshibiah
people.summary: Son of Seraiah in the genealogy of Simeon (1 Chr 4:35).

people.name: Jothan
people.summary: Son of Jahdai in the genealogy of Judah, among the Calebites (1 Chr 2:47).

people.name: Jubal
people.summary: Son of Lamech and Adah, 'the father of all who handle the harp and pipe'.
know: Ancestor of musicians (Gen 4:21)

people.name: Judah of Damascus
people.summary: Judah owned the house on Straight Street in Damascus where the newly blinded Saul stayed and prayed until Ananias came to him.
know: His house was on 'the street which is called Straight'.

people.name: Judas of Galilee
people.summary: Judas of Galilee led a revolt 'in the days of the enrollment'; he perished and his followers were scattered. Gamaliel cites him as a second example of a movement that came to nothing.
know: Led a revolt at the time of the census.
Cited by Gamaliel in Acts 5:37.

people.name: Judith (wife of Esau)
people.summary: Hittite wife of Esau, daughter of Beeri; Esau's Hittite marriages grieved Isaac and Rebekah.
know: Not Judith of the Book of Judith
Some interpreters equate her with Oholibamah of Gen 36

people.name: Julia
people.summary: Julia is named in the greetings of Paul's Letter to the Romans. Greeted with Philologus; perhaps a married couple.
know: Greeted with Philologus; perhaps a married couple.

people.name: Junia
people.summary: Junia, with Andronicus, was a relative and fellow prisoner of Paul, 'notable among the apostles', and in Christ before Paul.
people.catholic: St John Chrysostom praised her as a woman worthy to be called 'among the apostles'. With Andronicus, commonly thought to be her husband, she is honored as a saint; 'apostles' here is generally understood in the wider sense of missionaries.
know: Greeted with Andronicus in Rom 16:7.
Called 'notable among the apostles'.
A believer before Paul.

people.name: Jushab Hesed
people.summary: Son of Zerubbabel in the genealogy of the royal line of David (1 Chr 3:20).

people.name: Justus of Corinth
people.summary: Justus was a God-fearer at Corinth whose house was next door to the synagogue; Paul moved his teaching there when the synagogue rejected him.
know: Some manuscripts call him Titius Justus.
His house was next to the synagogue (Acts 18:7).

people.name: Kemuel
people.summary: A son of Nahor, Abraham's brother, by Milcah.
know: Called 'the father of Aram' (Gen 22:21)

people.name: Kenaz
people.summary: Son of Elah in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 4:15).

people.name: Keren Happuch
people.summary: Job's third daughter after his restoration (the name means 'horn of eye-paint').
know: Received an inheritance with her brothers (Job 42:15).

people.name: Keziah
people.summary: Job's second daughter after his restoration (her name means 'cassia', a fragrant spice).
know: Received an inheritance with her brothers (Job 42:15).

people.name: King Lemuel
people.summary: An otherwise unknown king to whom Proverbs 31 is attributed, recording 'the revelation which his mother taught him' — advice against wine and women's wiles, a charge to defend the poor, and (probably) the poem of the capable wife.
people.catholic: The poem of the 'worthy woman' (Prov 31:10-31) that closes Proverbs is read in the Church as a portrait of holy womanhood and has been applied to the Church and to Mary; it is read in the Lectionary (e.g. 33rd Sunday in Ordinary Time, Year A).
know: Author of Proverbs 31 (at least 31:1-9).
Taught by his mother (Prov 31:1).

people.name: Korah
people.summary: Son of Hebron in the genealogy of Judah, among the Calebites (1 Chr 2:43).

people.name: Laadah
people.summary: Son of Shelah in the genealogy of Judah, house of Shelah (1 Chr 4:21). Called 'the father of Mareshah'.

people.name: Ladan
people.summary: Son of Tahan in the genealogy of Ephraim (1 Chr 7:26). In the ancestry of Joshua.

people.name: Lahad
people.summary: Son of Jahath in the genealogy of Judah, house of Hur (1 Chr 4:2).

people.name: Lappidoth
people.summary: Husband of the prophetess and judge Deborah.
know: Deborah is called 'the wife of Lappidoth' (Jdg 4:4).

people.name: Libni
people.summary: Son of Mahli in the genealogy of Levi, among the Merarites (1 Chr 6:29).

people.name: Likhi
people.summary: Son of Shemida in the genealogy of Manasseh (1 Chr 7:19).

people.name: Linus
people.summary: Linus is one of the Roman Christians who send greetings to Timothy in Paul's final letter.
people.catholic: St Irenaeus (Against Heresies 3.3.3) records that the apostles Peter and Paul entrusted the office of bishop of Rome to Linus, 'of whom Paul makes mention in the Epistles to Timothy'. He is therefore honored as St Linus, the first successor of St Peter as Pope; he is named in the Roman Canon ('Linus, Cletus, Clement') and commemorated on September 23. His place at the head of the list of Roman bishops is a classic witness to apostolic succession.
know: Greets Timothy in 2 Tim 4:21.
Identified by St Irenaeus as Peter's first successor as bishop of Rome.
Named in the Roman Canon (Eucharistic Prayer I).

people.name: Lo-ammi
people.summary: Gomer's second son, named Lo-ammi ('not my people') as a sign of the broken covenant; God promises that those called 'not my people' will be called 'sons of the living God'.
people.catholic: St Paul (Rom 9:25-26) and St Peter (1 Pet 2:10) see the reversal 'not my people... my people' fulfilled in the Church, gathered from Jews and Gentiles.
know: Name means 'not my people'.
Reversed in Hos 1:10 and 2:23; quoted in Rom 9:25-26.

people.name: Lois
people.summary: Lois was Timothy's grandmother, in whom, Paul writes, a sincere faith 'lived first' before passing to Timothy's mother Eunice and to Timothy himself.
people.catholic: Honored as an example of grandparents who transmit the faith across generations.
know: Timothy's grandmother (2 Tim 1:5).
Often assumed to be Eunice's mother, though the text does not say whether she was Timothy's maternal or paternal grandmother.

people.name: Lucius
people.summary: Lucius is named in the greetings of Paul's Letter to the Romans. One of Paul's 'relatives' who sends greetings from Corinth; identification with Lucius of Cyrene or with Luke is uncertain.
know: One of Paul's 'relatives' who sends greetings from Corinth; identification with Lucius of Cyrene or with Luke is uncertain.

people.name: Lucius of Cyrene
people.summary: Lucius of Cyrene was one of the prophets and teachers at Antioch who sent out Barnabas and Saul after laying hands on them.
know: One of the Cyrenian believers who helped found the Antioch church (cf. Acts 11:20).
Laid hands on Barnabas and Saul (Acts 13:3).

people.name: Lysanias
people.summary: Lysanias is named as tetrarch of Abilene in the fifteenth year of Tiberius, when the word of God came to John the Baptist (Lk 3:1).
know: Named only in Luke 3:1.
An inscription from Abila confirms a tetrarch Lysanias in the early first century AD.

people.name: Maacah
people.role: Concubine of Caleb son of Hezron
people.summary: Maacah, a concubine of Caleb son of Hezron, bore Sheber, Tirhanah, Shaaph and Sheva (1 Chr 2:48-49).

people.name: Maacah
people.summary: A child of Nahor, Abraham's brother, by his concubine Reumah.
know: Child of Nahor and Reumah (Gen 22:24)

people.name: Maasai
people.summary: Son of Adiel in the genealogy of the priests who resettled Jerusalem (1 Chr 9:12).

people.name: Maaseiah
people.summary: Maaseiah son of Baruch, of the Shilonite clan of Judah, settled in Jerusalem in Nehemiah's day (Neh 11:5).

people.name: Maath
people.summary: Maath, son of Mattathias, appears only in Luke's genealogy of Jesus, which runs from Joseph back through David's son Nathan to Adam; he is listed as the father of Naggai (Lk 3:26).
know: Named only in Luke's genealogy (Lk 3:26).
Son of Mattathias; father of Naggai.

people.name: Maaz
people.summary: Son of Ram in the genealogy of Judah, among the Jerahmeelites (1 Chr 2:27).

people.name: Mahalalel
people.summary: Mahalalel is named in the genealogy of Judah, among those who settled in Jerusalem under Nehemiah (Neh 11:4).

people.name: Mahalath
people.summary: Mahalath, granddaughter of David through Jerimoth and of Eliab through her mother Abihail, married Rehoboam and bore him three sons.
know: Both her parents were of David's family

people.name: Mahath
people.summary: Son of Amasai in the genealogy of Levi, among the Kohathites (1 Chr 6:35). In the ancestry of Samuel and Heman the singer.

people.name: Mahlah
people.summary: Child of Hammolecheth in the genealogy of Manasseh (1 Chr 7:18). Not Mahlah daughter of Zelophehad.

people.name: Mahli
people.summary: Son of Mushi in the genealogy of Levi, among the Merarites (1 Chr 6:47). In the ancestry of Ethan the singer.

people.name: Malachi
people.summary: Malachi ('my messenger') prophesied in the 5th century BC to a discouraged post-exilic community, rebuking priests who offered blemished sacrifices, men who divorced the wives of their youth, and people who robbed God of tithes. He announced that the Lord would send his messenger to prepare the way and would send Elijah the prophet before the great and terrible Day of the LORD.
people.catholic: Malachi 1:11 — 'in every place incense will be offered to my name, and a pure offering' — is taught by the Council of Trent (Session XXII, ch. 1) to be fulfilled in the Sacrifice of the Mass, offered among all nations, and is echoed in Eucharistic Prayer III ('from the rising of the sun to its setting'). Jesus identifies John the Baptist as the messenger of Mal 3:1 and as the Elijah who was to come (Mt 11:10, 14; cf. Lk 1:17). Mal 3:1-4, the Lord coming suddenly to his Temple, is read on the feast of the Presentation (February 2).
know: Last book of the Old Testament in the Christian canon.
'A pure offering' among the nations (Mal 1:11) — the Mass.
'I send my messenger to prepare the way before me' (Mal 3:1).
Promise of Elijah's return (Mal 4:5-6), fulfilled in John the Baptist.

people.name: Malcam
people.summary: Son of Shaharaim and Hodesh in the genealogy of Benjamin (1 Chr 8:9).

people.name: Malchijah
people.summary: Son of Ethni in the genealogy of Levi, among the Gershonites (1 Chr 6:40-41). In the ancestry of Asaph the singer.

people.name: Malchiram
people.summary: Malchiram is listed among the sons of Jehoiachin (Jeconiah) the captive.
know: Born in the Babylonian exile

people.name: Malchus
people.summary: Malchus was the servant of the high priest whose right ear Simon Peter cut off with a sword at Jesus' arrest. Jesus ordered Peter to put away the sword, and Luke records that he touched the ear and healed it.
people.catholic: The scene shows Christ freely accepting his Passion ('the cup which the Father has given me') and healing even an enemy, his last miracle before the cross.
know: Servant of the high priest (Jn 18:10).
His ear was cut off by Peter (Jn 18:10).
Healed by Jesus (Lk 22:51).

people.name: Malluch
people.summary: Son of Hashabiah in the genealogy of Levi, among the Merarites (1 Chr 6:44). In the ancestry of Ethan the singer.

people.name: Manaen
people.summary: Manaen, 'the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch', was among the prophets and teachers at Antioch who commissioned Barnabas and Saul.
people.catholic: His presence shows the Gospel reaching even the court of Herod Antipas, who beheaded John the Baptist.
know: Raised with Herod Antipas (Acts 13:1).
A leader of the church at Antioch.

people.name: Maon
people.summary: Son of Shammai in the genealogy of Judah, among the Calebites (1 Chr 2:45). Called 'the father of Beth-zur'.

people.name: Mareshah
people.summary: Mareshah, of the Calebite clans, is named as 'the father of Hebron' (1 Chr 2:42); the name is also that of a Judahite town.

people.name: Mary of Rome
people.summary: Mary is greeted by Paul as one 'who labored much for us' in the church at Rome.
know: Greeted in Rom 16:6 for her labor.

people.name: Mary, mother of John Mark
people.summary: Mary was the mother of John Mark. Her house in Jerusalem was a gathering place where many were praying for Peter during his imprisonment, and Peter went there first after his miraculous release.
people.catholic: She is an early example of a house church, the domestic setting where the first Christians gathered for prayer. Some later tradition identifies her house with the place of the Last Supper, but Scripture does not say so.
know: Mother of John Mark.
Many gathered to pray in her house during Peter's imprisonment.
Rhoda was a servant in her house.

people.name: Mattatha
people.summary: Mattatha, son of Nathan son of David, appears only in Luke's genealogy of Jesus, which runs from Joseph back through David's son Nathan to Adam; he is listed as the father of Menan (Lk 3:31).
people.catholic: Luke traces Jesus' ancestry back to Adam, 'the son of God' (Lk 3:38), showing him as Saviour of the whole human race; unlike Matthew, his line descends through David's son Nathan rather than Solomon.
know: Named only in Luke's genealogy (Lk 3:31).
Son of Nathan son of David; father of Menan.

people.name: Mattathias son of Simon
people.summary: A son of Simon murdered with his father at the banquet in Dok.
know: Killed by Ptolemy son of Abubus (1 Macc 16:14-16).

people.name: Matthan
people.summary: Matthan, son of Eleazar, appears only in Matthew's genealogy of Jesus as the father of Jacob (Mt 1:15), in the line of David's royal heirs after the Babylonian exile.
know: Named only in Matthew 1 - a link in Jesus' royal Davidic line after the exile.
Son of Eleazar; father of Jacob.

people.name: Mattithiah
people.summary: Son of Shallum in the genealogy of the Korahite gatekeepers (1 Chr 9:31). He had charge of the baked offerings.

people.name: Medium of Endor
people.summary: On the eve of his last battle Saul, in disguise, asked a woman at Endor who had a familiar spirit to bring up Samuel; Samuel appeared and foretold Saul's death and Israel's defeat.
people.catholic: Saul's visit breaks the law he himself had enforced against mediums (1 Sam 28:3; Deut 18:10-12). The Church teaches that all recourse to mediums and conjuring the dead must be rejected (CCC 2116). Sirach 46:20 says Samuel prophesied after his death.
know: Saul had earlier banished mediums
Samuel's spirit foretold Saul's death
Fed Saul before he left

people.name: Mehir
people.summary: Son of Chelub in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chr 4:11).

people.name: Mehujael
people.summary: Son of Irad in the line of Cain; father of Methushael.
know: Part of Cain's line in Gen 4

people.name: Melea
people.summary: Melea, son of Menan, appears only in Luke's genealogy of Jesus, which runs from Joseph back through David's son Nathan to Adam; he is listed as the father of Eliakim (Lk 3:31).
know: Named only in Luke's genealogy (Lk 3:31).
Son of Menan; father of Eliakim.

people.name: Menan
people.summary: Menan, son of Mattatha, appears only in Luke's genealogy of Jesus, which runs from Joseph back through David's son Nathan to Adam; he is listed as the father of Melea (Lk 3:31).
know: Named only in Luke's genealogy (Lk 3:31).
Son of Mattatha; father of Melea.

people.name: Mesha
people.summary: Son of Caleb in the genealogy of Judah, among the Calebites (1 Chr 2:42). Called 'the father of Ziph'.

people.name: Mesha
